title_en: Cabin body and emergency shelter
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency rescue equipment, and discloses a cabin body which comprises a base, a top cover, a back plate, a placing rack and two side plates, wherein the top cover and the base are oppositely arranged at intervals, the two side plates are oppositely arranged between the base and the top cover in parallel, two ends of each side plate are respectively detachably connected with the edge of the base and the edge of the top cover, the back plate is arranged between the base and the top cover and is positioned at the same end of the two side plates, the lower end of the back plate is detachably connected with the base, the placing rack is arranged above the base and is positioned at one side of the top cover, two sides of the placing rack are respectively detachably connected with corresponding side edges of the two side plates, one side of the placing rack is detachably connected with the back plate, and one side of the placing rack is detachably connected with the top cover. The integral type water logging shelter body is skillfully decomposed into a plurality of independent components, so that the disassembly and assembly process can be simplified, the dependence on specialized tools is reduced, the time for converting from a transportation state to a use state is obviously shortened, and the emergency allocation efficiency of the water logging shelter is effectively improved.

title_en: A handheld sub terminal and operation method for mountain climbing information
title_ko: 휴대용 등산안내 보조단말기 및 그 운영 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 항법속성 기능을 갖고 있는 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스(DB)를 기반으로 한 휴대용 등산안내 보조 단말기 및 그 운영 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 산악 전체 영역과 등고선 데이터, 등산로 및 등산 코스 데이터, 주요 산악 시설명칭 등을 하나의 서비스 데이터베이스(DB)화하여 단말기의 저장 장치에 저장시키고, GPS수신기가 내장된 휴대용 등산안내 보조 단말기를 간단한 화면의 터치 조작을 통해 사용자에게 등산로 코스 안내 및 경유지(Way Point), 대피소, 고도 정보 등의 등산 테마 데이터를 2차원 평면도 또는 3D 조감도 형태로 다양한 등산안내 서비스를 제공할 수 있도록 구성되어 있는 휴대용 등산안내 보조 단말기와 그 운영 방법 및 데이터베이스 구축 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명에 따른 휴대용 등산안내 보조단말기는 GPS위성으로부터 사용자의 위치 정보를 수신하는 GPS 수신부; 산악의 배경 형상, 등산 코스 데이터 및 테마 정보 등의 데이터베이스가 격납되어 있는 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스와, 상기 각각의 데이터베이스를 실행 가능하도록 하는 다수의 운영 실행 프로그램이 함께 저장된 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스 저장부; 사용자 조작신호를 발생시켜 등산 전자지도 모드 또는 3D 조감도 모드 중 어느 하나의 선택을 가능하게 하는 키입력부; 및 상기 GPS 수신부에서 수신한 사용자의 위치 정보 또는 키입력부를 통해서 사용자에 의해 선택된 산악 전자지도 모드 또는 3D 조감도 모드 중 어느 하나와 매칭 되는 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스를 산악 전자지도 데이 터베이스 저장부에서 독출하고, 독출된 데이터베이스에 해당하는 운영 실행 프로그램을 실행시키고, 이를 표출부를 이용하여 표출되도록 제어하는 중앙제어부를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징적 구성으로 한다. 
       
     등산, 등고선, 등산로, 등산코스, 3D조감도, 산악, GPS, 네비게이션, 전자지도, DB, DEM, Navigation System

title_en: Shockproof hard disk machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hard disk machine takes precautions against earthquakes, it includes: a casing having a receiving space for receiving a hard disk drive; a printed circuit board, located in the accommodation space, having a controller and a first connector, wherein the controller can be coupled to the hard disk drive to perform signal conversion between the hard disk drive and the first connector, and the first connector can be coupled to a host and exposed out of the housing; and at least one shock absorbing spring plate inserted into one side of the hard disk drive to provide shock absorbing capacity to the hard disk drive.

title_en: Alarm capable of sending out multi-grade earthquake signal to periphery towns
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alarm capable of automatically propagating a plurality of scales of impending earthquake signals toward external cities and towns, which is composed of an alarm cabinet lower chassis and an outer shell, wherein an alarm part device frame, a plurality of pendulum spike shaft bases are arranged on the device frame, a pendulum spike shaft protrudes from each pendulum spike shaft base, and one pendulum spike shaft sleeve is matched, a pendulum inverse proportion rod is connected to the above of the shaft sleeve, a pendulum linkage rod is connected to the below of the shaft sleeve, the lower end of the linkage rod is connected to a pendulum; one annular contact disk is arranged at the top of each pendulum inverse proportion rod, and four bolts displaced by the adjusting contact disk are arranged at the circumference thereof. When the earthquake comes, an alarm circuit is switched off to send alarm and propagate outward. Because the overspreading and propagation velocity of an earthquake wave is much slower than the conduction velocity of electricity, if the automatic propagation alarm can be mounted in all the cities and the towns nationwide, when an earthquake centered on a city or town occurs, the impending earthquake signals are rapidly propagated to the cities, towns and rural areas in eight directions so that people at a far distance can have enough time to evacuate.

title_en: Method of providing emergency temporary housing to natural disaster evacuee
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for providing a natural disaster evacuee with emergency temporary housing assigned with a temporary home number so as to allow a relative and acquaintance of the evacuee and a natural disaster prevention center to specify the evacuee's location.  <P>SOLUTION: Based on the system wherein a computer 100 of a natural disaster prevention general center is connected with computers 101 to 107 of organizations involved in natural disaster prevention through Internet network and, moreover, a host server 10 of the natural disaster prevention general center includes various databases including a natural disaster damage prediction database 12, a method of providing emergency temporary housing to a natural disaster evacuee allows the organizations involved in natural disaster prevention to share information and cooperate to support the evacuee so that the evacuee moves into an emergency temporary home.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluating seismic capacity of building
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and an apparatus for evaluating a seismic capacity of a building, which enable an operator to easily know which portion of the building is lowered in seismic capacity, when the building is acted upon by an external force such as an earthquake and the like.  <P>SOLUTION: The apparatus includes: three-axis acceleration sensors S(S1-S27) each being disposed at a structure material in each virtual block B which is defined by dividing the building 20 into two or more parts; and a measuring/evaluating section which is connected to each three-axis acceleration sensor S and measures a displacement of the structure material in each virtual block B by using a detection signal from each three-axis acceleration sensor S, when the building 20 is displaced by the external force, and which evaluates the seismic capacity of the building 20, based on these measured values and a previously set displacement-allowed value of the structure material in each virtual block B. Therefore, the operator can easily know which portion of the building 20 is lowered in the seismic capacity, when the building is acted upon by the external force such as the earthquake and the like.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT
assignees: NAT INST OF ADVANCED IND SCIEN;MISAWA HOMES INST OF RES & DEV

title_en: High-altitude fire fighting truck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-altitude fire fighting truck comprising a suspending drive room at the lower part and a fire balloon of a working room fixedly provided with a high pressure hose, wherein the outlet of the hose is connected with a high pressure water gun and fixedly arranged at the working room; the fire balloon is accommodated at the accommodation carriage of the fire balloon, wherein a winding machine is fixed in the carriage, and the fire balloon is fixed on the winding machine through a tractor rope; the surface of the fire balloon is provided with a plurality of buckles along the ball body in latitudes; the drive room is larger than the working room; the accommodation carriage of the fire balloon is provided with a gas-filled tube in which a gas outlet faces to the inflation inlet of the fire balloon; the wall of the accommodation carriage of the fire balloon is provided with a drive room platform and a working room platform matched with the drive room and the working room, and the winding machine is fixed at the bottom; and one end of the tractor rope on the winding machine is fixedly arranged on the fire balloon. Through the high-altitude fire fighting truck, the fire balloon can be ascended and folded quickly, and the fire balloon can be protected.

title_en: Lattice polystyrene template
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lattice polystyrene template. A vertical surface of the template is symmetrical from top to bottom and from left to right; the upper part and the lower part of the plane center of the vertical surface of the template are cambered; two sides of the plane are symmetrically provided with displaced convex-concave fat edges; and the profile arcs of the template are buckled to form a cavity, and a plurality of cavities are arranged. Through changing the structure form of the polystyrene template, the structure form of the template is improved, and the plate bursting phenomenon existed in the construction process is remarkably reduced, so that the using amount of the concrete is further saved under the condition that the bearing capacity and earthquake resistant behavior of the overall structure do not change. The lattice polystyrene template is feasible in economy, simple in technology, easy to master and convenient for construction, and can be widely applied to the process of post-disaster reconstruction. The lattice polystyrene template effectively solves the defect of the single structure form of the existing lattice polystyrene template in China, and enables the novel wall structure in China to get a larger development.

title_en: Automatic scaling emergency shelter device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic scaling emergency shelter device, which mainly comprises hinge covers (1), connecting rods A (2), connecting rods B (3), motors (4), bolts (5), nuts (6), adjusting sleeves (7), lead screws (8) and self-locking devices (9), wherein a four-bar mechanism multi-layer flat basic structure (21) is formed by the connecting rods A (2), a vertical connecting structure (31) is formed by the connecting rods B (3), and the two structures are connected with each other to form a three-dimensional structural assembly of the device; the motors (4) are connected with the basic structure through the lead screws (8) and are uniformly distributed on the four pairs of hinge covers (1); the self-locking devices (9) are arranged on the relative inner sides of the hinge covers; the device has a compression resistance structure with certain strength and rigidity through the self-locking of the self-locking devices (9). The device can become an emergency shelter for people when a mine disaster occurs or houses collapse in earthquake collapse, and is unique in mechanism design, quick in starting and skilful in overall design concept; and due to selection of a proper material, the equipment has stronger compression resistance capacity, the personal safety can be guaranteed, and the device is easy to operate and low in cost and can become the emergency shelter for the people at a critical moment.

title_en: Living environment simulation experiment apparatus of emergency sheltering equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment simulation experiment apparatus, particularly relates to a human living environment-related human metabolism gas and harmful gas simulation experiment apparatus in the emergency sheltering equipment. The environment simulation experiment apparatus comprises a cabinet body and the experimental instruments arranged in the cabinet body, wherein the experimental instruments include a gas control apparatus, a heating apparatus and a humidifying apparatus. The environment simulation experiment apparatus can simulate the human metabolism gas and the harmful gas and provide the environment with different temperature and humidity, and is used for testing whether the environment of the sheltering equipment in the mine meets the technical requirement ruled by the environment standard needed for the refugees within rated protection time. The environment simulation experiment apparatus is small in volume, light in weight and convenient to move, can perform the detection experiment of the sheltering apparatus of which the capacity is 3-24 persons and the protection time is more than 120 hours, and is also suitable for providing detection experiment samples of the living environment in a seabed emergency sheltering cabin.

title_en: Escape capsule gas linkage control device for mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an escape capsule gas linkage control device for mine. The device comprises an air curtain tube, a spraying tube, a filter, a pressure reducer and a standby gas cylinder, wherein one end of the filter is connected with a compressed air pipeline; the other end of the filter is connected with one end of the pressure reducer through a connecting pipeline; the other end of the pressure reducer is connected with an aeration pipeline; another connecting pipeline is also arranged on the connecting pipeline between the filter and the pressure reducer, and is connected with the spraying pipe and the air curtain pipe; a control valve is arranged on the air curtain pipe, and is electrically connected with a mechanical valve; and the spraying pipe is connected with the standby gas cylinder through the connecting pipeline. At an emergency shelter constructed at a mine shaft at present, after a mine disaster happens, the system is matched with an underground compressed air device (the standby gas cylinder can be used under the condition that the compressed air is absent), the toxic and harmful gas can be isolated and removed while personnel enter the emergency shelter, the harmful gas can be removed more effectively, and thus, a good survival environment is provided for miners encountering the mine disaster.
assignees: Jiangsu dandilong heavy industry co ltd

title_en: Disaster risk area prediction device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately predict a risk area resulting from local heavy rain and to appropriately guide a person to an emergency shelter on the basis of a prediction.SOLUTION: A disaster risk area prediction device 1, which predicts a degree of risk from disaster due to precipitation in an object area, comprises: FA value calculation means 2 which divides a ground surface of the object area into meshes, assigns altitude data to each mesh, assumes that surface water on a given mesh flows out to one of the surrounding meshes with which the given mesh has a steepest downward slope, and calculates a FA value of the given mesh which is a value obtained by accumulating a number of the meshes from which the surface water thereon flows in the given mesh; FA value logarithmic conversion means 3 which obtains a logarithmic value of the FA value for each mesh; and display means 4 which divides the FA logarithmic values into a plurality of groups in accordance with magnitudes of the FA logarithmic values, and performs a screen display of the meshes to which identification information set for each group is assigned.

title_en: The combined earthquake isolating equipment of the Self-resetting that a kind of vertical bearing capacity is high
abstract_en: The invention discloses the combined earthquake isolating equipment of the high Self-resetting of a kind of vertical bearing capacity, comprise slidable panels, slide mass, elastic rubbery body and gusset piece, slidable panels is positioned at top, for the upper head plate of earthquake isolating equipment, gusset piece is positioned at bottom, for the bottom plate of earthquake isolating equipment, accommodation space is formed between slidable panels and gusset piece, slide mass and elastic rubbery body are positioned at accommodation space, slide mass is positioned at the central region of accommodation space, the top of slide mass contacts with the soffit of slidable panels, bottom and the gusset piece of slide mass are connected, elastic rubbery body is multiple, multiple elastic rubbery body is evenly arranged in the fringe region of accommodation space, be positioned at the periphery of slide mass, each elastic rubbery body upper, lower end is connected with slidable panels and gusset piece respectively, slide mass and multiple elastic rubbery body are that horizontal lattice-like distributes.Use can be inverted when earthquake isolating equipment separately establishes dust guard.Adopt the protected structure of this earthquake isolating equipment can reduce structural response when earthquake.

title_en: Gas coordinated control device of mineral rescue capsule
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas coordinated control device of a mineral rescue capsule. The gas coordinated control device comprises an air curtain pipe, a spraying pipe, a filter, a pressure reducer and a spare air cylinder, wherein one end of the filter is connected with an air compression pipe, the other end of the filter is connected with one end of the pressure reducer through a connection pipe, the other end of the pressure reducer is connected with an oxygenation pipe, the connection pipe between the filter and the pressure reducer is additionally provided with a connection pipe which is connected wit the spraying pipe and the air curtain pipe, the air curtain pipe is provided with a control valve, the control valve is electrically connected with a mechanical valve, and the spraying pipe is connected with the spare air cylinder through the connection pipe. According to the gas coordinated control device of the mineral rescue capsule, disclosed by the utility model, at present, an emergency shelter arranged under a mine is in matched connection with an underground air compression device by utilizing a system (the spare air cylinder can be used under the condition of no compressed air) after a mine disaster generates, and toxic and harmful gas is isolated and cleaned when persons enter the emergency shelter, so that the harmful gas can be more effectively removed, and an excellent living environment is provided for mine workers in the mine disaster.
assignees: Jiangsu dandilong heavy industry co ltd

title_en: Double-extension accommodation vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of special vehicles, and provides a double-extension accommodation vehicle. The double-extension accommodation vehicle is characterized by comprising a chassis, the lower portion of the chassis is provided with a vehicle-mounted power-taking power generating system, an electrical system and an automatic leveling hydraulic supporting leg, the rear end of the chassis is provided with a push-pull-type boarding ladder, the upper portion of the chassis is provided with a fixed heat-preservation compartment body with a door at the rear end, two sides of the fixed heat-preservation compartment body are respectively provided with an extension heat-preservation compartment body through extension mechanisms, the middle of the fixed heat-preservation compartment body is provided with double-layer beds, the rear end of each extension heat-preservation compartment body is provided with a rest room and a wash room, and double-layer folding beds are arranged in the two extension heat-preservation compartment bodies. The double-extension accommodation vehicle is compact in structure, reasonable in layout, strong in guarantee capacity and convenient to use, and flexibly guarantees life of persons providing disaster relief and dealing with emergencies and field operation workers.
assignees: HENAN COSTAR SHENQI SPECIAL VEHICLE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent box type direct current traction transformer station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent box type direct current traction transformer station. The intelligent box type direct current traction transformer station comprises a box type casing, wherein the box type casing is internally provided with an accommodation machine room. The intelligent box type direct current traction transformer station is characterized in that a bottom portion of the accommodation machine room is provided with a cable channel and an air conditioner air pipeline, a top portion of the accommodation machine room is provided with temperature control equipment, monitoring equipment and illumination equipment, the accommodation machine room is internally provided with an operation corridor, two sides of the operation corridor are provided with various types of cabinets and fire-fighting equipment, and a WDQ direct current cabinet and a KYN28A-12 high voltage cabinet respectively employ a handcart type structure. Through mutual cooperation of various electric equipment, intelligent unmanned operation can be realized, operation reliability of a direct current traction power supply system is greatly improved, operation maintenance cost is further reduced, moreover, an integrated box structure is employed, high integration of correlated electric equipment is realized, equipment space is fully utilized, and coordinative cooperation with a surrounding environment can be realized. The intelligent box type direct current traction transformer station further has properties of strong anti-impact capability, great heat insulation and strong temperature adjusting effect and can operate without capacity reduction integrally.
assignees: SUZHOU WANLONG ELECTRIC GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of drum type braking device
abstract_en: A kind of drum type braking device, including brake block static in brake rim and along with the brake rim of vehicle wheel rotation, the rubbing surface of brake rim arranges at least one annular ditch groove, and the rubbing surface of brake block is the face matched with annular ditch groove.The brake lining of the present invention sets groove, increases friction area, is not required to big stampede power or oil pressure.Also it is not required to use the brake rim being relatively large in diameter, just can improve the strength of brake.For ring-type V-shape ditch slot fit ring-type V-shape convex tendon, when ring-type V-shape groove is adjacent to completely with ring-type V-shape convex tendon (the two angle is identical), owing to the numerical value of V-shape convex tendon mean breadth is less times greater than the numerical value of V-shape groove mean breadth, V-shape convex tendon top is circular arc, V-shape convex tendon is displaced slightly forwards again, groove just produces huge clamping force, can effective brake, ring-type trapezoidal groove coordinate ring-type trapezoidal convex tendon situation as the situation of ring-type V-shape ditch slot fit ring-type V-shape convex tendon.

title_en: A kind of beam column ball pivot node
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of beam column ball pivot node, comprise: column, some crossbeams, be arranged on the bulb in column and the some steel arms be fixedly connected with crossbeam with bulb respectively, the ball seat that closes with the matching form of bulb is provided with and several are for holding the accommodation section of steel arm in column, ball head pivot point is positioned on the centroidal line of column, the height of projection of bulb is greater than the cup depth of ball seat, the inner surface of accommodation section and the external surface of steel arm have certain interval, during earthquake, bulb rotates in ball seat, make column and between crossbeam and floor, relative motion occurs, and make each composition component of building structure not produce mutual restraining function, be conducive to reducing geological process, in addition, column is connected with the no-cohesive prestressed reinforcement of crossbeam by rigidity, and the elastic restoring force that these no-cohesive prestressed reinforcements produce when earthquake can guarantee that building structure is returned to initial position after earthquake, also can alleviate the Structural defect that earthquake causes.

title_en: apparatus for induction reaction of molten steel
title_ko: 용탕의 반응 유도 장치 및 용탕의 반응 유도 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for inducing reaction of molten steel and a method for inducing reaction of molten steel. The apparatus for inducing reaction of molten steel comprises a furnace having an accommodation space accommodating molten steel therein; a pump which has an outlet on an upper side and an inlet on a lower side and pumps some of the molten steel up to a predetermined height or higher from the molten steel surface accommodated in the furnace; a molten steel passage installed above the furnace to circulate the molten steel which is discharged from the outlet and flows along a predetermined route by returning the molten steel to the furnace; and a reactant supplying nozzle supplying powder reactant to the molten steel discharged from the outlet. Therefore, the apparatus for inducing reaction of molten steel and the method for inducing reaction of molten steel can reduce time for producing a metal alloy, produce a high purity metal alloy, automate and mass-produce a metal alloy, freely increase capacity by arranging multiple sets of pumps and molten steel passages, and easily perform maintenance such as washing or fire extinguishing.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 용탕의 반응 유도 장치 및 용탕의 반응 유도 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 용탕의 반응 유도 장치는, 내부에 용탕을 수용하는 수용 공간이 형성되는 로; 하측에 흡입구가 형성되고, 상측에 배출구가 형성되며, 상기 로에 수용된 상기 용탕의 수면으로부터 일정한 높이 이상의 위치로 상기 용탕의 일부를 끌어 올리는 펌프; 상기 배출구로부터 배출된 용탕이 일정한 경로를 따라 흐르다가 상기 로로 회귀하여 순환될 수 있도록 상기 로의 상방에 설치되는 용탕 유로; 및 상기 배출구로부터 배출된 용탕에 분말 형태의 반응 물질을 공급하는 반응 물질 공급 노즐;을 포함하여 금속 합금의 제조 시간을 절감할 수 있고, 순도 높은 금속 합금을 제조할 수 있으며, 금속 합금의 자동화 및 대량 생산을 가능하게 하고, 다수 조의 펌프와 용탕 유로를 배치하여 용량을 자유롭게 늘릴 수 있으며, 세척이나 화재 소화 등 관리를 용이하게 할 수 있는 효과를 갖는다.

title_en: Assembling structure and fire fighting truck on a kind of high polymer material
abstract_en: The invention discloses assembling structure on a kind of high polymer material, including the carriage body support made of polypropylene material, the carriage body support includes the compartment top plate being connected with parapet, the lower end both sides of the compartment top plate are connected to before railway carriage or compartment shrouding after shrouding and railway carriage or compartment, before the railway carriage or compartment bottom plate is provided with behind shrouding and railway carriage or compartment between shrouding, and the lower end of the bottom plate is connected with gusset plate, the middle part of the gusset plate is provided with the lappet of arch；The bottom plate upper end is provided with some diaphragm plates and the midfeather to match, and the diaphragm plate and midfeather form some accommodation spaces with the carriage body support.Beneficial effects of the present invention are：The present apparatus is simple for structure, in light weight, and antiseptic property is superior；Fire fighting truck with assembling structure in the overall height molecular material railway carriage or compartment tank integral type is also with simple for structure, and in light weight, antiseptic property is superior, disclosure satisfy that the requirement in during the fire-fighting vehicle life-span.

title_en: A kind of isolation type chemical-oxygen self-rescuer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of isolation type chemical-oxygen self-rescuer, comprise can, respiratory system, oxygen candle, medicinal cupping and air bag, described respiratory system is communicated with medicinal cupping at the top of medicinal cupping with oxygen candle, air bag is communicated with medicinal cupping in the bottom of medicinal cupping, and respiratory system, oxygen candle, medicinal cupping and air bag are placed in the spatial accommodation of can.The self-rescuer that the utility model proposes is 45min self-rescuer, has carried out systematic research, make this device can meet the requirement of 45min respiratory capacity and breathing time with the device of minimum volume from the size of explosive payload, single unit system and the size of medicinal cupping; In order to strengthen the sealing property of this device, improve for the connected mode between the sealing means of upper and lower covers, the manufacture craft of air bag and each ventilation member, make the sealing property of this device more superior, security performance is high.
assignees: SHAANXI STAR COAL MINE SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Frameless temporary or emergency shelter
abstract_en: A foldable, frameless emergency shelter is constructed from a radial array of bendable yet rigid panels such as of a foamed plastic. Panels have adjoining edges with matching convexly curved profiles. The edges are always held to each other with a flexible fastener such as an adhesive tape. During erection, a flat panel inherently deforms into a curved cylindrical tapered shape enclosing a space. A door and an optional floor are provided. The shelter has a rigid conical cap including holes for guy ropes, a door and an optional window.

title_en: Damaged replaceable composite column structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of damaged replaceable composite column structure, comprise: a core square steel pipe, one ground beam end plate and four replaceable steel boxes, core square steel pipe is located on ground beam end plate, its lower end closed, its upper end is by the affixed RC post of some first built-in structures and offer the opening of an accommodation RC post lower end, ground beam end plate is fixedly arranged on grade beam by the second built-in structure, four replaceable steel boxes respectively dismountable wall being arranged at core square steel pipe with around this core square steel pipe, rear this kind of structure can only in periphery there is buckling failure in replaceable steel box position in shake, and only occur slight destruction at core square steel pipe position or do not occur destroying, the controllability of damage location is realized under the prerequisite ensureing vertical bearing capacity, excellent earthquake resistance, and after shake, pillar is resetted, replaceable steel box is pulled down, installation replaces with intact steel box and repaiies fast afterwards with the shake achieving structure.

title_en: Follow-on self-control power consumption unbonded prestressed concrete frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved self-control energy-consumption unbonded prestressed concrete frame, which comprises a common reinforced concrete column and an unbonded prestressed concrete beam on which an improved self-control element is arranged, wherein the improved self-control element comprises a steering device, a deformation box, a positioning rod, a pressure bearing plate and filling foam. The stress part of the improved self-control element is made of glass fiber board material, and by utilizing the brittle failure property of the glass fiber board material, the self-control element keeps a normal stress state and does not change under normal use and a normal earthquake state, and under rare earthquakes, the stress transmitted to the self-control element by the device reaches a certain threshold value, the stress part of the self-control element is subjected to brittle failure immediately and is displaced to a certain degree in the stress direction, so that the prestressed tendons are loosened, the stress in the prestressed tendons is reduced, the bearing capacity of the frame is reduced, a beam hinge energy dissipation mechanism is finally formed, and the energy dissipation capacity of the unbonded prestressed concrete frame is improved.

본 발명의 적재관리를 통한 음식물류 폐기물 종량제 처리 시스템은 통신망에 연결되고, 지방 자치 단체 또는 배부처로부터 납품받은 납부필증의 납부필증 코드 정보를 판독하여 입력하고, 배출자가 구입한 납부필증에 대한 납부필증 코드 정보를 배출자 정보와 함께 저장하는 판매처 단말기와; 상기 통신망에 연결되고, 납부필증을 구입한 배출자가 배출한 음식물류 폐기물의 용기에 부착된 납부필증으로부터 납부필증 코드 정보를 판독하고, 음식물류 폐기물을 수거하도록 판독된 납부필증 코드 정보를 검증 요청하는 수거처 단말기 및; 납부필증 제작업체에서 제작된 납부필증에 대한 납부필증 코드 정보를 저장하고, 상기 통신망을 통해 상기 판매처 단말기로부터 납부필증 판매에 따른 판매 정보와 배출자 정보를 전송받고, 상기 수거처 단말기로부터 납부필증 코드 정보의 검증 요청이 있으면, 저장된 납부필증 코드 정보와 상기 수거처 단말기로부터 판독된 납부필증 코드 정보를 비교하여 검증 처리하고, 검증 결과를 상기 수거처 단말기로 전송하며, 상기 수거처 단말기로부터 수거된 납부필증에 대한 수거 정보가 전송되면, 상기 배출자 정보와 상기 수거 정보를 이용하여 배출자별로 음식물류 폐기물의 배출량을 판별하고, 판별 결과에 따라 배출자의 배출 이력을 통해 배출량이 감소되었으면, 감량된 배출량에 대응하는 마일리지를 산출하여 배출자 정보에 마일리지를 적립시키는 음식물류 폐기물 종량제 관리 서버를 포함하고, 상기 음식물류 폐기물의 용기는 적재량 센서가 구비되며, 상기 음식물류 폐기물 종량제 관리 서버는 상기 적재량 센서를 통해 수집된 음식물류 폐기물의 용기의 적재량이 특정 기준을 만족하는 지 여부를 이용하여 수거가 필요한 음식물류 폐기물의 용기를 검출한 다음, 상기 수거처 단말기로부터 입찰받은 희망수거비와 배출자의 선택 정보를 기초로 수거업체를 매칭시키고, 최종적으로 매칭된 수거처 단말기에 상기 음식물류 폐기물의 용기의 위치, 수거경로 및 수거예상시간 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 수거 오더를 제공한다.

title_en: Internet of Dogs' Identifiers System and Method of Operation for Trained Assistance Animal Status and Verification
abstract_en: Identifying trained assistance animals expected at a gateway or accommodation by using wireless communications. It includes operating a trained assistance animal identity center, an active animal garment, and a wireless mobile communication device which variously download a plurality of protected ID files (portfolio) containing identity documentation of registered trained assistance animals expected at a location during a period of time; initiate a verification process by an active controlled garment that is worn by a microchipped trained assistance animal; return an encrypted Identity reference string; either request identity documentation from a service center database or match with a member of the portfolio; display the identity documentation (images, names, descriptions, trained behaviors, audio); or record the verification of a trained assistance animal at a time and place. Subscriber reservation systems access the service center to initiate a download of expected ID files. Trained assistance animal trainers provide identity documentation for graduates.

title_en: Fire first-aid hood capable of achieving atomization cooling through splicing of multiple detachable structures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency helmet which is formed by splicing a plurality of detachable structures to carry out atomization cooling, and the structure of the fire emergency helmet comprises: the filter pipe is positioned on the lower side end face of the heat-proof sleeve and is fixedly connected with the heat-proof sleeve, the sewing belt is positioned on the front end surface of the heat-proof sleeve and is fixedly connected with the heat-proof sleeve, and the sewing belt is connected with the heat-proof sleeve through an internal transverse chain and an internal longitudinal chain, thereby the internal matching head cover frame and the movable output frame can be divided into a plurality of small parts, the headgear frame is divided into a front part and a rear part by the upper suction frame, the mounting sleeve at the lower end is an arc-shaped structure which is attached to the human body, thereby better protecting the installation of the disaster-stricken personnel, simultaneously, the sealing sleeve can be displaced through the movable frame below, and the cooperation through the pipeline is discharged inside gas fast, prevents inside gaseous ponding, and the inside water route that is equipped with simultaneously can make the inside temperature of headgear drop faster, prevents that the consciousness that high temperature caused is fuzzy.

title_en: It is a kind of to warn fire fighting truck with amplifying for removable aerial ladder
abstract_en: Fire fighting truck is warned with amplifying for removable aerial ladder the invention discloses a kind of, including car body, aerial ladder ontology and aerial ladder platform, described car body itself has dynamical system and matched control system, the aerial ladder stage+module is on aerial ladder ontology, mobile aerial ladder mechanism is installed on the aerial ladder ontology and car body, on the car body and is located at mobile aerial ladder structure side comprehensive function mechanism is installed；The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows, there is removable amplifying for aerial ladder to warn fire fighting truck easy to use for this, it is rationally distributed, effectively aerial ladder is horizontally displaced by mobile aerial ladder mechanism thereon, the lateral position that can be rescued with fast offset to needs when rescuing it between same floor, it is thus more efficient, and working area when fireman operates is effectively increased by high-order aerial ladder slide construction thereon, complete protection is provided.
assignees: CHONGQING FIRE FIGHTING SAFETY TECH RESEARCH SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: A kind of cylinder cam-type damper response amplifying device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of cylinder cam-type dampers to respond amplifying device, including rack, the ball-screw of movable type installation, the nut being threadedly coupled with ball-screw, reciprocal cylindrical cam mechanism, damper；Reciprocal cylindrical cam mechanism includes the cylindrical cam mutually fixed with nut, the follower lever matched with cylindrical cam；On the rack, the other end of damper is connected on follower lever for one end connection of damper, and ball-screw is relatively fixed in the axis direction of ball-screw through cylindrical cam, nut and rack from the central through hole of cylindrical cam.The relative storey displacement and speed responsive amplification that amplifying device can generate building structure are responded, so that damper is given full play to energy dissipation capacity in limited design runlength and is displaced and does not fail, belongs to earthquake engineering technical field.

title_en: A kind of community endowment service management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to administrative skill field of supporting parents, specifically a kind of community endowment service management system, including data processing module, Teaching Module, active module, administration module and psychological comfort module；The data processing module, active module, administration module and psychological comfort module are based on computer terminal operation, and the data processing module includes information acquisition unit, occupational classification unit, personality taxon, Accommodation allocation unit, screening unit, screening criteria unit and statistic unit；The active module is used to carry out recreation according to the information for moving in old man；For exercising supervision to the state of personnel in activity, and in real time, the true personality of old man is moved in analysis to the administration module；The psychological comfort module is used to carry out psychological comfort to the unsociable and eccentric old man that moves in, and enhances emotion；The sense of worth of old man can be improved in the present invention, improves life interest, and help each other between different old men, advantageously reduces the probability that old man incurs danger.

title_en: Manual driving device of motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual drive arrangement of motor, including spacing seat and shaking hand, spacing seat is injectd and is had the open accommodation space in both ends, and wherein one end links firmly with the afterbody of motor organism, and the motor tail axle stretches into accommodation space, and the afterbody is the non-circular columnar structure at least at the tail axle, and the shaking hand includes the main part and follows the cover body that the main part extends, the end wall of the cover body is equipped with the non-circular columnar structure matched with card hole with the tail axle, and cover body activity cartridge is in accommodation space to can follow accommodation space and move between embolia the tail axle and the position that the tail axle separates. When the motor normally operates, the sleeve body is located at a position separated from the tail shaft, the hand crank does not rotate along with the tail shaft, on one hand, noise can be reduced, on the other hand, damage to the human body or property safety can be avoided, when the motor cannot operate due to power failure or other emergency situations, the sleeve body of the hand crank is manually driven to be sleeved in the tail shaft, the tail shaft of the motor can be driven to rotate through the hand crank, and therefore the motor is manually driven to operate.
assignees: GUANGDONG ANKUAI INTELLIGENT SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of emergency shelter is taken refuge the prediction technique and system of population demand
abstract_en: It takes refuge the prediction technique and system of population demand the invention discloses a kind of emergency shelter, this method comprises: determining that population suffered from disaster's scale B caused by the medium above extent of the destruction occurs for regional architecture structure to be predicted using Seismic Vulnerability Analysis algorithm i ；It treats and predicts that the anti-seismic performance of regional infrastructure system is assessed, determine that infrastructure system interrupts caused population suffered from disaster's scale W j ；Obtain the timing node t in the relevant project period of area to be predicted 0 ；According to the B i 、W j 、t 0 , substitute into the emergency-sheltering size of population prediction model constructed according to TCBID theory；Output emergency shelter is taken refuge the predicted quantity M of population demand.This method matches demand and supply more by the fixed demand of taking refuge of dynamic evaluation, and science, rational prediction city are taken refuge population demand, improves urban safety and takes precautions against natural calamities efficiency.

title_en: Combine Passive Energy Dissipation Structures design method and combination energy-dissipating and shock-absorbing skyscraper
abstract_en: The present invention combines the mechanical property feature of all kinds of damping devices, propose a kind of combination energy-dissipating and shock-absorbing design method and a kind of combination energy-dissipating and shock-absorbing skyscraper, combined application velocity profile damper and viscous damper in high building structure, pass through the position and mechanics parameters of active accommodation energy-consumption shock-absorption device, all kinds of damping devices are made to play a role stage by stage under different level geological processes: under frequently occurred earthquake effect, only velocity profile damper dissipation energy, the unyielding energy consumption of viscous damper only provides rigidity for structure；Under set up defences earthquake and rarely occurred earthquake effect, metal damper steps into surrender, makes up the shortcomings that viscous damper energy dissipation capacity reduces, and realizes the optimization of Structural Energy Dissipation efficiency.
assignees: TONGJI ARCH DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of double rank sliding friction dampers of brace type
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of double rank sliding friction dampers of brace type, and the channel steel beam section of H profile steel beam section and web fluting including web fluting, oval notch of different sizes is respectively set in H profile steel beam section both ends, to correspond to first-order slip-flow section and second-order slip-flow section；H profile steel beam section, friction element, channel steel beam section steel are fixed by frictional high-strength bolts and butterfly spring, by adjusting disc spring quantity and the pretightning force of frictional high-strength bolts, to realize double rank sliding mechanisms；It can guarantee building structure in frequently occurred earthquake, single order, which rises to slide, is displaced the friction energy-dissipating that takes the lead in, and in rarely occurred earthquake, second order plays sliding section and not only can guarantee enough bearing capacities but also had biggish friction energy-dissipating ability；Improve destabilization problems outside frcition damper face；Each part replacement is easy to maintain；And the butterfly spring rigidity that the utility model uses is big, restorability is strong, can be substantially reduced bolt pretightening loss, in tension and compression deformation so as to guarantee that damper plays maximum damping capacity.
assignees: JIANGSU LANKE SHOCK ABSORPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Super large is displaced dual damping and tensile support
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to earthquake-resistant structure security fields, provides a kind of super large displacement dual damping and tensile support, including support, steel damper, viscous damper and vertical tension component, and seat board is each provided with one piece of lower seat board end plate in its both sides along direction across bridge under support；Support upper base plate is respectively set in its bottom there are two upper base plate barb；The bottom of upper base plate barb is hooked in lower seat board end plate lower end and collectively forms vertical tension component；The quadrangle of support is respectively arranged with replaceable steel damper；Viscous damper is along bridge, to installing on the support, both ends are fixedly connected with the bottom of upper base plate respectively each by a viscous damper block.The utility model can both provide vertical bearing capacity, horizontal bearing capacity, turning power, displacement capacity under normal use, also has the function of dual shock absorption, the seismic response of bridge structure under geological process can be effectively reduced, and small volume, simple and compact for structure, good damping effect, each component are conveniently replaceable, repair.
assignees: HENGSHUI CHENGRUI RUBBER PRODUCT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of lighting fitting case for field tent hospital
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of lighting fitting case for field tent hospital, including cabinet and case lid, case lid is hinged with cabinet, case lid can be overturn along hinged place, the cabinet is upper opening structure, it is internally provided with buffering lining made of vibration damping sponge, buffering lining is placed directly in cabinet or is pasted onto the bottom of cabinet, and buffering lining is provided with the accommodation groove to match with each lighting fitting shape.The protrusion that the groove and box opening that the utility model is circumferentially arranged by case lid edge are circumferentially arranged matches to form seal case structure, and relief hole is arranged in body side, can prevent rainwater from penetrating into and box house is kept to be consistent with atmospheric pressure；The locking plate being arranged on case lid and the snap-fitted use being arranged on cabinet form retaining mechanism.The lighting fitting case is designed using case group formula, and structure is simple, light weight, at low cost, is readily transported and is carried, is particularly suitable for the Mobile medicals places such as field tent hospital, field emergency rescue station.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF SYSTEM ENGINEERING ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SUPPORT TECH

title_en: The measuring method of Alpine Grasslands Second productivity dynamic response under snow disaster load
abstract_en: The present invention provides the measuring method of Alpine Grasslands Second productivity dynamic response under snow disaster load, the component that will affect Alpine Grasslands Second productivity is decomposed into snow disaster load force, the maintenance energy of Grassland ecosystems function, avenge disaster prevention and control force, four functional modules of livestock products productivity, interaction between the component and state of four modules, it influences each other and restricts the size and level of the secondary production capacity of Alpine Grasslands, the Alpine Grasslands ecosystem is under the stress and load action of snow disaster evil, meadow Second productivity support system will occur to be displaced accordingly, snow disaster load force is bigger, phylogenetic displacement is also bigger, and meadow Second productivity is smaller.The present invention portrays the logical relation of snow disaster load-displacement response, and the size of meadow Second productivity is portrayed according to system displacement inverse, improves science, objectivity and the accuracy of quantitative expression meadow Second productivity.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Method of decision making based on modeling portfolio of public building
title_ko: 공공건축물 그린 리모델링 포트폴리오 의사결정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of making a decision on a green remodeling portfolio of a public building. The method comprises the steps of: classifying a public building by a complex unit not by a single building unit and setting standard models for a public building by classifying the public building for each usage/size in order to determine necessity and economic efficiency of green remodeling; classifying a size of a building according to the total area to set the standard models for a public building and classifying a use of each building such as a business use, an educational use, a residential use, a commercial use, a medical use, an industrial use, an accommodation service use, etc., which display different energy patterns based on a building energy consumption classification criteria published by the national statistical office; setting priorities of the standard models according to a green remodeling portfolio budget allocation process; and allocating the budget and businesses by setting sampling errors of the budget. According to the present invention, it is possible to promote a remodeling market.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공공건축물 그린 리모델링 포트폴리오 의사결정 방법에 관한 것으로서, 공공건축물을 단일 건축물 단위가 아닌 집합 단위로 분류하여 그린 리모델링 필요성 및 경제성을 판단하게 하기 위하여 용도별/규모별로 구분하여 공공건축물 표준모델을 설정하는 단계; 공공건축물 표준모델 설정을 위하여 연면적에 따라서 건축물 규모를 구분하고, 통계청에서 발표한 건축물에너지 소비량 분류기준을 근거로 상이한 에너지 사용패턴을 나타내는 업무용, 교육용, 주거용, 상업용, 의료용, 공업용, 숙박용 및 기타에 해당하는 각 건축물 용도를 구분하는 단계; 그린 리모델링 포트폴리오 예산배분 프로세스에 따라 표준모델의 우선순위를 설정하는 단계; 및 예산의 표본오차를 설정하여 예산 및 사업배분을 수행하는 단계를 포함하는 공공건축물 그린 리모델링 포트폴리오 의사결정 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Friction composite buckling restrained energy-dissipation brace
abstract_en: The invention discloses a friction composite buckling restrained energy dissipation brace which comprises a friction device and a buckling restrained energy dissipation brace, wherein the buckling restrained energy dissipation brace comprises a middle baffle, a core material component and an outer restrained sleeve, the outer restrained sleeve is sleeved in the middle of the core material component, two ends of the outer restrained sleeve are fixedly connected with the middle baffle, the friction device is arranged at two ends of the core material component and comprises an end baffle, a pressing plate, friction materials and an outer sleeve, the outer sleeve is sleeved at two ends of the core material component, two ends of the outer sleeve are respectively and fixedly connected with the end baffle and the middle baffle, the pressing plate and the friction materials are arranged in the outer sleeve, and bolts penetrate through waist-shaped holes in the core material component to connect the pressing plate and the friction materials with the core material component. According to the invention, when the core material component is elastically deformed and displaced, the friction device consumes energy, so that the defect that buckling restrained energy-consuming supports only can yield and consume energy under medium and large shocks is overcome, the energy consumption capacity of the buckling restrained energy-consuming supports under small shocks is improved, the interlayer displacement angle of the small shocks is reduced, and the structural damage caused by the earthquakes is reduced.

title_en: Application method of artificial intelligence method in ecological geological environment bearing capacity evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application method of an artificial intelligence method in evaluation of bearing capacity of an ecological geological environment, which comprises the following steps: 1) Collecting information of a resource supply side; 2) Removing impurities from the information of the resource supply side; 3) Analyzing environment accommodation information; 4) Inputting social influence data; 5) Analyzing social influence data; 6) And (4) carrying and analyzing the environment. According to the invention, the data acquisition in the ecological geological environment bearing capacity evaluation is converted from the original complex manual operation into the cooperative operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the crawler-type unmanned vehicle and the satellite, and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the crawler-type unmanned vehicle and the satellite jointly form a positioning type information acquisition, analysis, comparison and input system, so that the geological environment bearing capacity data can be conveniently acquired, analyzed and screened, thereby avoiding the manual complex operation, avoiding the data loss caused by manual error, and realizing the intelligent analysis and processing, thereby greatly improving the analysis and processing efficiency of the geological environment bearing capacity.

title_en: Method for optimizing production planning and pollution discharge right transaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing production planning and pollution discharge right trading, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring basic data; s2, establishing a profit maximization model; s3, establishing a pollution discharge right distribution and transaction constraint cluster; s4, establishing a capacity constraint set; s5, carrying out robust optimization on the constraint conditions containing uncertain parameters in the pollution discharge right distribution and transaction constraint cluster and the accommodation amount constraint cluster respectively, and obtaining the pollution discharge right distribution amount constraint condition and the accommodation amount constraint condition through dual change correspondence; and S6, taking the pollution discharge right distribution amount constraint condition and the accommodation amount constraint condition as the constraint conditions of the profit maximization model, and optimizing the production planning and the pollution discharge right transaction. The method establishes a profit maximization model and a constraint condition thereof through environmental data conforming to natural laws and existing market data, and maximizes economic benefits of a target area through optimizing production planning and pollution right trading under the constraint condition conforming to water quality standards.

title_en: Emergency shelter site selection and resource distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency shelter site selection and resource distribution method and system, comprising the following steps: the method is characterized in that a grade difference thought is introduced on the basis of emergency shelter site selection and resource distribution process, victims and emergency shelters are graded according to injury degree and service level, and resource demand points of different grades have different priorities for resources; on the premise that the total capacity of the refuge station meets the total demand of the victims, a graded refuge site selection model is established with the aim of minimizing the total evacuation distance of the victims at low cost; on the basis of a location selection model for graded refuge, an allocation model is established with the aim of minimizing the amount of unsatisfied resources and considering the shortage of resources; combining the two models into one model, and simultaneously considering emergency shelter site selection and resource allocation; and solving the model by adopting a nesting algorithm. The invention provides a scheme capable of selecting addresses and distributing resources in consideration of different service levels of shelters and different resource priorities from the perspective of different injury degrees of victims.

title_en: Heating and heat-preserving integrated accommodation shelter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heating and heat-preserving integrated accommodation shelter, belonging to the technical field of accommodation shelters, comprising a shelter frame, wherein the top and the bottom of the shelter frame are respectively provided with a top plate and a bottom plate, and the top plate mainly comprises two layers of aluminum plates a, a steel frame a and a polyurethane filling layer a; the application of the accommodation shelter in plateau alpine regions is realized, a heating and heat preservation integrated composite structure system is developed by matching with a photovoltaic-assisted multi-energy comprehensive utilization technology and a film heating technology, a matched and assembled heat preservation and sealed accommodation shelter enclosing structure and a sealed heat preservation technology thereof are researched and designed, process devices such as heating and oxygen supply and a stable mode and an optimized configuration scheme of bedding and bedding are realized, a connection mechanism with self-sealing closed pressure bearing, no cold bridge or small heat transfer area is realized, a support mechanism without cold bridge or small heat transfer area is developed, the heating and heat preservation effects are good, and guarantee and measures are provided for emergency rescue arrangement and guarantee projects.
assignees: SHANDONG LONGHE ENERGY SAVING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voting token System of local government bond and operation method thereof
title_ko: 지자체 공채형 보팅 토큰 시스템 및 그 운용 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a municipal bond-type voting token system and a method for operating the same, including: an issuance server transmitting an issued token to an intermediary server and receiving a value corresponding to the value of the token; the intermediary server performing electronic wallet storage and listing on the token received from the issuance server, performing settlement by receiving a token purchase request, a token purchase price, and a fee from a customer terminal, and storing the token corresponding in number to the token purchase price in a customer token electronic wallet matching the identification ID of the customer terminal; and the customer terminal performing settlement corresponding to the purchase request with respect to the token listed on the intermediary server and receiving customer token electronic wallet identification information storing the token corresponding to the amount of settlement. According to the present invention, intermediation is performed such that a token purchased by an investor is collected after exchange into an electronic voucher usable at a local online/offline store (traditional market, local shopping mall, local sports/performance watch, local accommodation facility, or local restaurant). Accordingly, existing tokens used simply for trading in cryptocurrency markets can be given various and integrated values, ranging from local governments, local commercial areas, culture, investors, and consumers, and regional economic revitalization can be achieved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지자체 공채형 보팅 토큰 시스템 및 그 운용 방법에 관한 것으로서, 발행한 토큰을 중개서버로 전송하여 토큰의 가치와 대응하는 금액을 수신하는 발행서버; 발행서버로부터 수신한 토큰을 전자지갑에 저장하여 상장시키고, 고객 단말기로부터 토큰 구매요청, 토큰 구매대금 및 수수료를 수신하여 결제를 수행하며, 토큰 구매대금과 대응하는 개수의 토큰을 고객 단말기의 식별ID와 매칭한 고객토큰 전자지갑에 저장하는 중개서버; 중개서버에 상장된 토큰에 대한 구매요청과 대응하는 결제를 수행하고, 결제된 금액과 대응하는 토큰이 보관된 고객토큰 전자지갑 식별정보를 수신하는 고객 단말기를 포함한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 투자자가 구매한 토큰을 지역내의 온/오프라인 매장(재래시장, 지역형 쇼핑몰, 지역연고 스포츠/공연 관람, 지역 숙박시설 또는 지역 음식점)을 통해 사용가능한 전자상품권으로 환전하여 회수하도록 중개함으로써, 가상화폐 시장에서 단순 거래 용도로만 사용되던 종래의 토큰을 지자체, 지역상권, 문화, 투자자 및 소비자에 이르기 까지 다양하고 융합된 가치를 부여하고, 지역경제를 활성화하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Accommodation public security management method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of computers, and discloses a method, a device and a system for lodging security management, which are used for solving the problem of low query efficiency of a management system, and the method comprises the following steps: the client receives and analyzes a query request instruction sent by a user, and acquires and sends corresponding information to be queried to the server; the server reads and returns content data matched with the information to be inquired to the client side in a preset cache region based on the received information to be inquired; and finally, rendering the preset query page by the client based on the returned content data and the preset rendering rule, and presenting the rendered query page. By adopting the mode of indexing the cache database, the content data matched with the information to be queried is read, the reading time of the server is greatly shortened, the rendering time of the client is shortened, the generation time of the rendered query page is shortened, and the query efficiency of the system is further improved.

title_en: Emergency shelter CT structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an emergency shelter CT structure, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a shelter box body, wherein an isolated scanning room and an isolated operation room are arranged in the shelter box body; a CT scanning device consisting of a CT scanning frame and a diagnosis bed matched with the CT scanning frame is arranged in the scanning room; one side of the scanning room is provided with an isolation door, and one side of the operating room is provided with a door; the four walls, the top and the ground in the scanning room are all isolated protective layers; a distribution box and a control device for controlling the CT scanning device are arranged in the operating room. The utility model provides a shelter CT is independent of outside the hospital, can remove it to any place through the vehicle, has stronger flexibility, compares with fixed point hospital simultaneously, reducible cross infection's risk. Spacing the suite and scan reduces the chances of a doctor coming into face-to-face contact with the patient and reducing the risk of infection for the doctor. Meanwhile, an isolation protective layer is arranged between the scanning chambers, so that radiation leakage can be prevented.

title_en: Method for optimizing bus running efficiency
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for optimizing bus running efficiency. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring station passenger flow arrival distribution; acquiring the number of waiting passenger flows; acquiring the residual accommodation capacity of the bus passengers; predict the number of getting-on vehicles at the next station if The waiting passenger flow can all get on the bus, namely the number of the passengers getting on the bus under the condition At this time, the number of people Q staying in the platform i‑zhi 0; if it is At this time, it is stated that the waiting passenger flow cannot all board, that is, the number of boarding passengers is The number of people staying in the platform at the moment is Predicting the number of getting-off persons at the next station; determining the maximum value of the passenger flow for getting on and off the train; and predicting the standing time. By predicting the length of the stop of the bus and optimizing the bus running schedule, the invention can reduce the stop times in the running process of the bus, improve the arrival punctuality rate of the bus in the special bus and improve the running efficiency of the bus.

title_en: Transfer passenger flow visual analysis method applied to rail transit transfer station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transfer passenger flow visual analysis method applied to a rail transit transfer station, which comprises the following steps: drawing a transfer plan according to basic information of a certain transfer station, and the area of a station hall and the accommodation capacity of the station hall; the transfer relationship between two transfer stations is represented by an arrow, and the colors of the stations and the arrow are changed according to the transfer passenger flow data acquired from the background; drawing a transfer diagram by adopting a quadrant representation method, wherein two transfer lines are taken as two coordinate axes, and the included angle of the two coordinate axes is ninety degrees; the invention has the characteristics of displaying the transfer passenger flow data of the rail transit to the user more clearly and intuitively, and facilitating the user to quickly and intuitively know the transfer passenger flow between lines and the basic information of the transfer station.

title_en: Install in hidden fire hydrant of town road or building floor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hidden fire hydrant installed on a municipal road or a building floor, which belongs to the technical field of fire hydrant equipment and comprises the following components: a fire hydrant; a placing cavity; the lifting assembly comprises a lifting platform, the lifting platform is arranged at the bottom of the placing cavity, an opening which is matched with the connecting piece and is used for the connecting piece to pass through and be communicated with the inner cavity of the fire hydrant is formed in the top of the lifting platform, the lifting platform and the fire hydrant are detachably installed through the fixing assembly, the lifting platform is vertically displaced through the lifting piece, and the lifting piece is arranged in the placing cavity and is used for driving the fire hydrant to extend out of the ground from the placing cavity; a fixing component and a sealing component. The invention aims to provide a concealed fire hydrant installed on a municipal road or a building floor, which has the capability of adjusting the water outlet position when fire fighting equipment is insufficient, can conceal the fire hydrant and effectively saves ground resources.

title_en: Tunnel emergency shelter and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel emergency shelter and a using method thereof. The refuge cabin is buried underground, and the main channel is arranged at the top of the refuge cabin. The valve is arranged at the top of the main channel. The stable seat is sleeved on the surface of the refuge cabin. The shield tunnel emergency shelter and the using method thereof are characterized in that a refuge cabin, a valve, a stabilizing seat, a driving mechanism, a main channel and an arc channel are matched with each other. So that the invention can drill another channel nearby the invention by the drill bit after the initial channel opening is blocked by falling rocks, and meanwhile, people can rapidly leave the refuge chamber 1 through the arc-shaped channel. The tunnel rescue system is greatly convenient for personnel to use, the rescue speed is also improved, and the personal safety of workers in the tunnel is ensured.

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment classification storage mechanism for fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment storage, in particular to a classified storage mechanism of fire fighting equipment for a fire fighting robot, which comprises a storage box main body, a supporting mechanism, an opening and closing mechanism, a first storage mechanism, a second storage mechanism and a third storage mechanism; when the fire extinguishing device is used, the fire extinguishing device can be directly and rapidly rotated conveniently in the preparation stage through the corresponding rack and gear structure, and the fire extinguishing device can be conveniently used; the second storage mechanism is arranged in the middle of the inner cavity of the storage box body, and the waterproof belt is well limited through the matching of the opening and closing mechanism and the corresponding spring clamping block structure, so that the condition that the water belt is tangled and knotted is avoided, and the use process is convenient; settle third receiving mechanism in the bottom of containing box main part inner chamber, through corresponding rack and pinion drive assembly, conveniently carry out nimble regulation to the accommodation space for storage space is more even facing not unidimensional fire engine can distribute, has avoided storage space's waste.
assignees: HANGZHOU YITU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Information processing program, information processing method and information processing device
abstract_en: To output information on vacant houses that can be provided as evacuation shelters upon occurrence of disaster.SOLUTION: A disaster information reception unit receives information on disaster-stricken districts, refers to a resident DB, generates a target district list screen that displays households living in the disaster-stricken districts, and identifies the households (disaster-stricken households) that require evacuation based on input from the local government staff. Then, a matching unit identifies information on vacant houses that can be provided as evacuation shelters (excess/deficiency information) from information on the identified disaster-stricken households and information on the vacant houses of public housing other than the disaster-stricken districts, and outputs it to local government terminals via an output unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Square cabin of forest fire-fighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a forest fire control equipment shelter of putting out a fire, including shell body and inner deck, the inner deck setting is inside the shell body, with the shell body is connected, the inner deck is provided with bearing groove and bearing mechanism, there is bearing space in the bearing groove, bearing groove is provided with first track, bearing mechanism is provided with the wheel that rolls, the wheel that rolls cooperatees with first track, bearing mechanism can follow first orbital movement in the bearing groove, bearing mechanism is provided with accommodation space. The fire extinguishing equipment is placed in the bearing mechanism, the disaster relief personnel need to open the bearing mechanism to take out the fire extinguishing equipment, the rolling wheels are matched with the first rail, friction is reduced by the rolling of the rolling wheels, work required by the emergency personnel to open the bearing mechanism is reduced, time required for taking out the fire extinguishing equipment is shortened, and the disaster relief efficiency is improved.
assignees: TIANBEN INTERNATIONAL TECH DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Upward-moving high-flame-retardant steel fireproof window
abstract_en: The invention discloses an upward-moving high-flame-retardant steel fireproof window, and relates to the technical field of fireproof windows. The window comprises a window frame, wherein the top in the window frame is rotatably connected with an upper window; the bottom end of the upper window is hinged with a lower window; the bottom end of the lower window is hinged with a limiting end plate; two ends of the limiting end plate are respectively matched with the window frame in a sliding way; clamping frames which are mutually clamped with the window frame are sleeved in the two ends of the limiting end plate; a spring is sleeved between one end of the two clamping frames and the two ends of the limiting end frame. The window frame, the upper window, the lower window, the limiting end plate, the clamping frame and the spring are matched for use, the upward-moving opening-closing type structure is adopted, the clamping frame sleeved inside two ends of the limiting end plate is clamped with the window frame mutually under the action of the spring, the upward-moving position of the lower window is limited, the window can be opened completely, the ventilation performance is good, the accommodation experience of residents is improved, the situation that a person in danger rapidly escapes in a fire disaster is guaranteed, and the practicability is strong.
assignees: JIANGSU SHENGYANG FIRE DOOR IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent system and method for guiding people air defense evacuation shelter in real time by utilizing two-dimensional code
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for guiding personnel to prevent air evacuation and shelter in real time by utilizing two-dimensional codes, an intelligent system, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out air attack threat area division on a city and carrying out threat environment grade evaluation; the mobile terminal acquires current position information; the server matches the threat environment level of the area where the position is located according to the received position information, generates corresponding marking information according to the threat environment level and sends corresponding instruction information to the mobile terminal; the mobile terminal receives and displays the instruction information; and planning a path by the mobile terminal. According to the method, different marking information is respectively displayed on areas with different threat levels according to the attack threat degree of the air attacks possibly suffered by each area in the city during war and the positioning data of the mobile terminal, and peripheral evacuation areas or sheltering places are pushed pertinently according to the threat levels, so that people in the air attack defense fight are accurately guided to evacuate and shelter.

title_en: Novel emergent shelter intelligence CT
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel intelligent CT of an emergency shelter, which comprises a base, wherein a box body is arranged at the upper end of the base, a disinfection device is arranged inside the box body, and a movable door is arranged at one side of the disinfection device; a shell is arranged on one side of the box body, the shell is movably matched and connected with the box body, a sealing door is arranged at the joint of the shell and the box body, the sealing door is movably matched and connected with the box body, and a sterilizer is arranged on the shell close to the upper end of the sealing door; a storage box is arranged in the shell and is communicated with the sterilizer; the lower end of the storage box is provided with a controller which is electrically connected with the sealed box; the lower end of the base is provided with an electric power storage device, the electric power storage device is fixedly connected with the box body, and the electric power storage device is electrically connected with the sealing door, the controller and the disinfection device; the utility model discloses simple structure, convenient to use can short-term test, has improved the work efficiency who detects.
assignees: GUIZHOU ZHEMING MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource accommodation support device and resource accommodation support method
abstract_en: To provide a resource accommodation support device and resource accommodation support method in which optimal resource allocation is achieved in consideration of the difference in the provision form for each resource.SOLUTION: A resource accommodation support device 10 has a matching processing unit 32. A matching processing unit 32 acquires a resource-providing offer list 117 showing a resource-providing form of the resources capable of being provided by a resource provider, and a resource-providing wish list 118 showing the resource-providing form wished by a resource receiver. The matching processing unit determines the combination between the resource provider for delivering resources and the resource receiver on the basis of these information. The resource-providing offer list 117 and the re-resource-providing wish list 118 include information showing the type of the resources, respectively. The matching processing unit 32 determines the combination on the basis of the type of the resources.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: One-stop administrative approval and efficiency supervision equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of administrative supervision approval equipment, and discloses a one-stop administrative approval and efficiency supervision equipment, which comprises an administrative approval supervision device, wherein a display screen is fixedly arranged on the front side of the administrative approval supervision device, a card reading device is fixedly arranged on the top of the administrative approval supervision device, a maintenance box plate is movably arranged on the right side of the administrative approval supervision device, a fixed clamping plate is fixedly arranged on the left side of the maintenance box plate, the one-stop administrative approval and efficiency supervision equipment drives a transmission shaft and a mechanical gear to rotate by rotating a rotary button matched with a power transmission belt, the mechanical gear rotates to drive a mechanical rack to translate and a movable rod to translate and a telescopic spring and a support rod to drive the movable rod to move, the movable clamping short shafts on the two sides are contracted and displaced towards the middle under the tension, so that the movable clamping short shafts and the fixed clamping plate can be released from clamping, the quick maintenance and inspection of the internal elements of the administrative examination and approval monitoring device by the user are realized.
assignees: NANJING KINGKONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency shelter with modular retractable structure
abstract_en: Following post-disaster needs that should be addressed promptly, timely provision of shelter is a priority because it is effective in post-disaster tolerance. This need is met through an emergency shelter with a retractable structure. A shelter that is lightweight and would be set up with the least number of people, and also has a high setup speed can be applied in all areas with no installation training. Moreover, the advantage of an expandable structure that can be retracted and keep the environment safe is also considered. Also, modular structures make it possible for the units to be incorporated and provide larger spaces suitable for different numbers of people. This point can develop the field related to post-disaster reconstruction and be helpful in resolving pertinent issues.

title_en: Risk avoiding transfer method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk avoiding transfer method which comprises a flood flooding condition obtaining step, a transfer condition confirming step and a transfer route planning step.
