The refuge area is judged to be a surplus village or an overflow village by determining the accommodation threshold amount, the capacity to be transferred and the occupied capacity of the refuge area, so that the situation that only transfer in the village or transfer among the villages and towns is needed is determined, and a route is planned preliminarily. The inner flooded area then determines the target transfer point by identifying the closest refuge area, and then plans a specific route based on the evasive area between the two. The invention considers various conditions encountered during refuge and plans a route according to different conditions, thereby ensuring that personnel in an internal inundated area can be safely transferred as soon as possible.
assignees: ZHEJIANG DAYU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Community earthquake emergency evacuation space optimization design method based on behavior simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a community earthquake emergency evacuation space optimization design method based on behavior simulation, which comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a virtual environment analysis model reflecting a real high-density community; s2: establishing a post-earthquake high-density community emergency evacuation space analysis model; s3: constructing an emergency evacuation simulation model of personnel in a high-density community after earthquake; s4: optimizing and integrating the layout of the space of the community emergency shelter; s5: establishing a high-density community emergency refuge time satisfaction coverage model; s6: and simulating the post-earthquake emergency evacuation dynamic process of community personnel in the high-density community space unorganized and organized scenes respectively, and comparing and verifying the scientificity of division of the organized evacuation service responsibility areas. The community earthquake emergency evacuation space optimization design method based on behavior simulation can be used for researching the post-earthquake emergency evacuation of urban high-density communities, optimizing the high-density community emergency evacuation space and improving the post-earthquake emergency evacuation and guaranteeing capacity of the high-density communities.

title_en: Assembled multi-limb L-shaped special-shaped column capable of recovering functions and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an assembled multi-limb L-shaped special-shaped column with a restorable function and an assembling method thereof, wherein an L-shaped supporting surface comprises three groups of supporting frames and three groups of force-holding steel structures correspondingly arranged on the supporting frames, the force-holding steel structures are wrapped with force-holding rubber plates, core columns can be matched with the force-holding steel structures to transfer loads to brackets, and in the process, the force-holding rubber plates are positioned in local areas on the upper parts of the brackets and can generate elastic compression deformation, so that the top plate and the force-holding plates are relatively displaced; the L-shaped special-shaped column arranged in the structure is suitable for corners of a building, has strong structural stability, ensures that the L-shaped special-shaped column has enough torsion resistance, can meet the function of replacing the damper, prolongs the service life of the structure, and can self-reset under the action of small earthquake or medium earthquake.

title_en: Anti-collision guardrail
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-collision guardrail. Anticollision barrier includes: the device comprises a base, a buffer mechanism and two anti-collision mechanisms; the buffer mechanism is arranged on the base and comprises an installation cavity, the installation cavity is formed in the base, a moving block and two first springs are arranged in the installation cavity, a T-shaped block is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the moving block and extends into the base and is in sliding connection with the base, and the top end of the moving block extends out of the base and is in sliding connection with the base. The anti-collision guardrail provided by the utility model has the advantages that the buffer mechanism is arranged, so that the support plate can be quickly displaced when the guardrail is impacted by a vehicle, the impact of the vehicle is avoided to a certain extent, meanwhile, the first spring is arranged, the absorption of partial energy when the vehicle is impacted is realized, the buffer capacity of the guardrail is improved to a certain extent, and great casualties and losses of lives and properties of people are avoided.
assignees: HEBEI HUAJIU METAL PRODUCTS CO LTD

title_en: Safe ladle transfer device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses safe ladle transfer equipment, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate close to the left side, a first bearing is fixedly connected at the position of the fixed plate close to the center, a threaded rod penetrates through the inner cavity of the first bearing, the left end of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with a hand wheel, the top of the bottom plate close to the right side is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the top of the fixed block is provided with a round block, the left side of the round block is fixedly connected with a second bearing, the mutual matching of all the parts ensures that the steel ladle has the function of simultaneously clamping the inside and the outside of the steel ladle, so that the equipment has the advantages that the steel ladle can not be displaced when the steel ladle is transported by the transportation device after the equipment clamps the steel ladle, thereby ensuring the safety of personnel and equipment in the transportation process and avoiding casualties and property loss caused by accidents in the transportation process.
assignees: YIMINGSHENG GUANGZHOU AUTOMOBILE STEEL PARTS CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting engineering is with fire partition roll curtain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-proof partition rolling curtain for fire engineering, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a motor is arranged on one side of the equipment main body, a fixed block is arranged in the equipment main body, a bearing is arranged in the fixed block, a rotating shaft is arranged on the inner side of the bearing, a hinge is arranged on the outer ring surface of the rotating shaft, a fire-proof curtain is arranged on the inner side of the hinge, a valve is arranged on the outer surface of the fire-proof curtain, a smoke-blocking device is arranged below the fire-proof curtain, a water bag is arranged in the fire-proof curtain, a connecting hose is arranged at the upper end of the water bag, a supporting plate is arranged on the inner side of the smoke-blocking device, a telescopic spring is arranged on the lower surface of the supporting plate, a limiting groove is arranged in the smoke-blocking device, the supporting plate and the telescopic spring are descended by arranging the supporting plate, the telescopic spring, a connecting block and a partition pad, and when the telescopic plate descends to the bottom end of the partition pad, the partition rolling curtain is matched with the connecting block by the limiting spring, the separation pad is displaced to the outer surface of the fire-proof curtain, thereby preventing the toxic gas from overflowing from the bottom end of the fire-proof curtain to cause injury to personnel.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SINGTAI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Large-accommodation-capacity cable bridge capable of adjusting wiring assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable bridge with adjustable wiring components and large holding capacity, which relates to the technical field of cable bridges and comprises a bearing box and a waterproof cover, wherein a plurality of cable supporting plate components are arranged in the bearing box and are distributed in an upper layer and a lower layer, so that more cables can be laid in the bearing box compared with the traditional cable bridge, the holding capacity of the cable bridge is improved, the cable supporting plate components are distributed in layers, the cables can be distributed in a dispersed manner, heat can be quickly dissipated, the cables can be prevented from being wound in a staggered manner, the cable maintenance difficulty in the later period can be avoided, each cable can be fixed between two arc-shaped clamping plates by a positioning component when the cables are laid, the cables are independent of other cable bundles, the condition that the cables are laid in an excessively concentrated manner, the heat cannot be dissipated timely, and a fire disaster is caused is avoided, in addition, the distance between the two arc-shaped clamping plates can be adjusted according to the diameters of the cables, thereby being suitable for the cable laying of various specifications.
assignees: HANGZHOU XIAOSHAN CONSTANT INCIDENCE LINE EQUIPMENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Split type movable CT emergency shelter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a split type movable CT emergency shelter which comprises a fixing device and a locking device arranged in the fixing device, wherein the fixing device comprises two bases, sliding grooves are formed in positions, close to two sides, of the tops of the bases, and clamping grooves are formed in positions, close to two ends, of the tops of the bases. According to the design of the emergency shelter, the base, the fixing plate, the connecting frame, the limiting rod, the inserting rod, the fixing rod, the side plate and the top plate are matched with each other, so that the emergency shelter is stable in overall structure and cannot shake or collapse, meanwhile, radiation of a CT machine cannot leak, then the position of the fixing plate is fixed through the matching of the locking mechanism and the locking block, the fixing plate is firm and cannot shake, the emergency shelter can be normally used, and meanwhile, compared with a traditional emergency shelter, the emergency shelter is convenient to disassemble, assemble and transport.
assignees: SHANDONG DONGLII MEDICAL SPECIAL INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Forest environment value-based selective cutting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest environment value-based felling selecting method and a forest environment value-based felling selecting system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: acquiring basic data of a forest to be selectively cut; determining the natural growth rate and the maximum environmental capacity of the forest to be selectively cut according to the basic data of the forest to be selectively cut; determining the selective cutting strength based on the total amount of trees before cutting and the total amount of trees after cutting of the forest to be selectively cut; determining a selective cutting period according to the selective cutting intensity and the natural growth rate; determining the maximum selective cutting intensity on the premise of not reducing the maximum environmental accommodation capacity according to the set indexes of the forest ecological environment condition; determining the carbon seal storage of forest products according to the selective cutting period; determining the total carbon seal storage amount according to the carbon seal storage amount of the forest product and the carbon seal storage amount of the forest; determining the relation between the total carbon sequestration amount and the selective cutting strength; obtaining a comprehensive score based on scores of carbon sequestration corresponding to different purposes; and obtaining the selective cutting area of the forest to be selectively cut according to the maximum selective cutting intensity and the total forest area corresponding to the highest comprehensive score.

title_en: Processing device for energy-storage luminous paint for emergency shelters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of luminescent paint processing, in particular to a processing device for energy-storing luminescent paint of emergency shelters, which comprises a lifting cylinder, wherein a piston rod of the lifting cylinder is connected with a lifting beam, two ends of the lifting beam are respectively provided with a main shaft and a motor, the main shaft is connected with a dispersion disc, a cylinder body of the lifting cylinder is connected with a supporting arm, a notch is formed on the supporting arm, the main shaft is arranged in the notch, the supporting arms at two sides of the notch are respectively connected with a slide block through guide rails, the slide block is connected with a connecting arm, one end of the connecting arm far away from the slide block is connected with a semi-annular scraping block, the inner cambered surfaces of the two semi-annular scraping blocks are oppositely arranged, the inner wall of the semi-annular scraping block can be matched with the outer wall of the main shaft, the supporting arm is provided with a driving mechanism for driving the two slide blocks to move in opposite directions or back to back, the utility model has the advantages of reasonable design, can clear up the main shaft fast, and the life height of clearance part.

title_en: Working method of breathing air pressure reduction system suitable for emergency shelter of shelter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a working method of a respiratory air pressure reducing system for emergency shelter, which is suitable for a shelter, and comprises the following steps: s1, the air pressure of the compressed air in the high-pressure air bottle group is P0, and the air pressure of the compressed air is reduced to P1 after the compressed air passes through the primary pressure reducing mechanism; step S2, after the air output from the primary pressure reducing mechanism passes through the secondary pressure reducing mechanism, the air pressure is reduced to P2; and step S3, releasing the air output from the two-stage pressure reduction mechanism into the environment through the output mechanism for the breathing of the person. The invention can lead the finally output gas flow to be stabilized at 480 cubic meters per hour through the matching of the first-stage pressure reducing mechanism, the second-stage pressure reducing mechanism and the output mechanism, can be used by a plurality of persons in the shelter for a long time, ensures the life safety of the persons before the rescue is reached, and strives for time for the rescue.
assignees: DRAGON ENERGY TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing evacuation routes by each transportation modes in disaster
title_ko: 재난 시 교통수단 별 대피 경로 산출 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for calculating evacuation routes by transportation means in a disaster, which can select an optimal shelter by reflecting road congestion in accordance with the locations of shelters in a disaster. According to one aspect of the present invention, the method for calculating evacuation routes by transportation means in a disaster is realized on a processor and comprises: a step of selecting a shelter candidate among predesignated shelters; a passage assigning step of a personal transportation means for running to the shelter candidate for the personal transportation means; a step of calculating passage time for each link of a road network in accordance with the passage assignment of the personal transportation means; a step of selecting a candidate evacuation route of public transportation means in accordance with the passage time for each link; and a step of calculating total evacuation time of the public transportation means and the personal transportation means, and determining whether to reselect the shelter candidate in accordance with the total evacuation time.
abstract_ko: 재난 시 교통수단 별 대피 경로 산출 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 프로세서상에서 구현되는 재난 시 교통수단 별 대피 경로 산출 방법으로서, 기 지정된 대피소 중 대피소 후보지를 선정하는 단계와; 개인 교통수단에 대해 상기 대피소 후보지까지 운행을 위한 상기 개인 교통수단의 통행 배정 단계와; 상기 개인 교통수단의 통행 배정에 따라 도로 네트워크의 링크 별 통행시간을 산출하는 단계와; 상기 링크 별 통행시간에 따라 대중 교통수단의 후보 대피 경로를 선정하는 단계와; 상기 개인 교통수단과 상기 대중 교통수단의 총 대피시간을 산출하고, 상기 총 대피시간에 따라 상기 대피소 후보지를 재선정 여부를 결정하는 단계를 포함하는, 재난 시 교통수단 별 대피 경로 산출 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The application provides a geological disaster early warning device, including chassis and fixed connection in the dead lever of chassis roof, still include: the bottom reinforcing part is connected to the bottom wall of the underframe, and the input end of the bottom reinforcing part penetrates through the underframe and extends towards the inside of the fixing rod; the height adjusting component comprises a screw rod which is rotationally connected to the inner wall of the fixed rod and a lifting rod which is connected to the inner wall of the fixed rod in a sliding manner through a limiting groove, and the lifting rod is in threaded connection with the screw rod; the crank part is connected to the outer wall of the fixed rod and matched with the bottom reinforcing part and the height adjusting part; and the early warning component is fixedly connected to the top end of the lifting rod. Can highly adjust the early warning in this application, increased the practicality of device, the installation and the later maintenance of the equipment of being convenient for, accommodation process is steady simultaneously, and cooperation spring and damping carry out the shock attenuation to the siren, avoid causing the damage to equipment in accommodation process, and the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Method for calculating comprehensive index of bearing capacity of regional resource environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating a regional resource environment bearing capacity comprehensive index, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring regional resource environment bearing capacity measurement and calculation data consisting of socioeconomic development data and natural resource environment data; and constructing a windmill-quadrilateral model for the resource bearing capacity index RCI, the environmental accommodation capacity index ECI, the ecological adaptability index EAI and the socioeconomic development capacity index SDI of the region to be detected to obtain a resource environment bearing capacity comprehensive index REBCI of the region to be detected, and determining the resource environment bearing capacity state of the region to be detected by comparing the resource environment bearing capacity comprehensive index REBCI with the standard balance index. According to the method, the REBCI is measured and calculated through modeling fusion of the RCI, the ECI, the EAI and the SDI, and then the state of the limitation of the bearing capacity of the resource environment is obtained. The invention has important scientific and practical guiding significance for establishing and perfecting the early warning monitoring mechanism of the bearing capacity of the regional resource environment and formulating and implementing the territorial space planning.

title_en: Rapidly constructible emergency shelter with internal suspended bases
abstract_en: Millions of people yearly become homeless due to natural disasters. Incidents such as earthquakes and floods can cause a lot of damages and homelessness to a large number of people. So, the timely provision of shelter is a priority. This need is met through a lightweight emergency shelter with a high setup speed that can be applied in all areas with no installation training. Furthermore, a modular shelter with the least material waste in its assembling procedure can influence retaining the environment. This matter can have a significant impact on conserving vital resources. This issue can develop the field of post-disaster reconstruction and help resolve related difficulties.

title_en: Water environment capacity verification method based on control unit water quality target classification management
abstract_en: The invention provides a water environment capacity verification method based on control unit water quality target classification management. The method comprises the following steps: s1: a monitoring section is arranged, and the water environment quality is monitored; s2: dividing the management and control categories to obtain management and control unit categories, and evaluating the emission of pollution sources in each management and control unit; s3: adopting SWAT model and river channel hydrodynamic water quality model coupling to establish a river basin output and river channel water quality relation model of runoff and non-point source load, and calculating the water environment capacity of each control unit; s4: and (3) according to the requirements of the water quality targets of the watershed, a pollutant reduction scheme is formulated and refined to each management and control unit. The method of the invention optimizes the total pollutant emission reduction strategy and the like by researching the environmental accommodation upper limit of the social and economic development of the land control unit and using the water environment capacity as the constraint, thereby solving the problems of economic development mode, industrial structure, space layout, energy structure adjustment and transformation, and providing technical assistance for building important ecological barriers on the upper stream of Yangtze river.

title_en: Shelter allocation device, shelter allocation method, and program
abstract_en: This shelter allocation device comprises: a first acquisition unit which acquires the respective positions of disaster victims when a disaster occurs; a second acquisition unit which acquires, for the disaster victims, estimation values of the respective timings for canceling evacuation; and an allocation unit which acquires a result of allocating the disaster victims to certain shelters, respectively, for each division interval obtained by dividing a period, by solving an integer planning problem that is intended to minimize the sum of a cost required for the disaster victims to move from the respective positions to the respective shelters among a plurality of shelters, a cost required for the victims to move between the respective shelters in the period until the cancellation of evacuation, and an operation cost for the plurality of shelters. Thus, the shelter allocation device enables the allocation of the shelters in consideration of a period in which the disaster victims use the shelters.

title_en: Scenic spot area security management method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a scenic spot area security management method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the number of users in the target area based on the positioning of the users in the scenic spot area; determining a pedestrian volume threshold value of the target area based on the environmental characteristics of the target area; and under the condition that the number of the users is larger than the people flow threshold value, carrying out safety management on the target area. According to the scenic spot area safety management method and device, the personnel distribution conditions of different positions in the scenic spot area are counted, the personnel accommodation capacity corresponding to different positions in the scenic spot area is specifically analyzed by combining the environmental characteristics in the scenic spot area, and therefore users of different positions in the scenic spot area are managed, the number of personnel in different areas is reasonably controlled, crowding and treading are avoided, and safety of the users is guaranteed.
assignees: INSPUR COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Tooth embedding method of information identification body for emergency situation and disappearance prevention of denture wearer and application linkage service method of tooth embedded type information identification body
title_ko: 틀니 착용자의 위급상황 및 실종방지를 위한 정보식별체의 치아 매립방법 및 치아 매립형 정보식별체의 어플리케이션 연동 서비스 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tooth embedding method of an information identification body for preventing an emergency situation of a denture wearer and disappearance of dentures, and an application linkage service method of a tooth embedded type information identification body, the tooth embedding method comprising: a first step (S1) of forming an accommodation groove (10) by machining a groove on the surface of a tooth (5) of completed dentures (2) or partial denture with a hand piece or partially cutting the same with a milling machine; a second step (S2) of inserting and embedding an information identification chip (20) into the accommodation groove (10) so as not to outwardly protrude from the accommodation groove (10); a third step (S3) of forming a composite resin part (30) by filling the accommodation groove (10) in which the information identification chip (20) is embedded with a composite resin; a fourth step (S4) of curing and fixing the composite resin part (30) on the tooth (5) by means of a photopolymerization action by irradiating ultraviolet rays to a protrusion part (31) and an area around the same with a photopolymerizer (41); a fifth step (S5) of grinding the cured protrusion part (31) with a grinder so as to match the surface of the tooth (5) in a horizontal line while polishing the same; and a sixth step (S6) of forming a coating layer (60) by applying a coating agent on the ground composite resin part (30).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 틀니 착용자의 위급상황 및 실종방지를 위한 정보식별체의 치아 매립방법 및 치아 매립형 정보식별체의 어플리케이션 연동 서비스 방법에 관한 것으로 틀니 및 부분틀니에 NFC, 비콘(Beacon) 등의 RFID와 위치추적이 가능한 GPS를 매립하는 기술을 바탕으로 제작된 스마트한 틀니로서 착용하는 고령자 및 치매환자는 물론 잠재적 치매환자, 병원이력, 치과 정보이력이 있는 일반인 등의 위급상황 발생 시 어플리케이션을 통하여 틀니착용자의 병력정보를 즉각 확인할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 빠른 병력조회로 골든타임을 확보할 수 있고, 또한 실종사고 발생 시 위치 및 신상정보를 즉각 확인할 수 있으며 정보 식별체를 틀니의 치아 내부에 안정적으로 매립할 수 있도록 함과 아울러, 식별 어플리케이션을 통하여 정보식별체에 등록된 보호자와 틀니착용자에게 틀니 세척정보 시작과 종료를 문자로 전송 알림 서비스를 제공하고 위급상황에 놓인 실종노인, 장애인 등의 정보(인적사항)를 GPS를 통한 실종된 지역 어플리케이션 가입자에게 실종된 사람의 인적사항(이름, 특징, 얼굴사진 등)을 단체 문자를 전송할 수 있으며, 긴급 문자를 받은 그 지역의 다운로드된 어플리케이션의 사용자가 실종자를 찾으면 어플리케이션내의 제보하기를 통하여 그 지역의 위치를 전송할 수 있도록 하기 위해, 완성된 틀니(2) 또는 부분틀니의 치아(5) 표면에 핸드피스로 홈가공하거나 밀링기로 부분절삭가공하여 수용홈(10)을 형성하는 제1단계(S1); 상기 수용홈(10)에 건강정보 및 신상정보가 인식되는 식별수단이 포함된 정보식별칩(20)을 수용홈(10) 외측으로 비돌출되도록 삽입 내장하는 제2단계(S2); 상기 정보식별칩(20)은 고령자 또는 치매환자 등의 이름, 혈액형, 전화번호, 주민등록번호, 병원이력을 포함하는 개인신상정보가 저장된 NFC칩이거나, 그 대상의 위치를 파악하는 아이비콘(iBeacin)으로 된 스틱(20a) 형태 또는 시트(20b) 형태로 형성되고, 상기 정보식별칩(20)이 매립된 수용홈(10) 내에 복합레진을 충진하여 복합레진부(30)를 형성하는 제3단계(S3); 상기 복합레진부(30)는 수용홈(10)의 외측으로 돌출부(31)가 형성되도록 하고, 상기 수용홈(10)의 외측으로 형성된 돌출부(31)를 포함한 주변에 광중합기(41)로 자외선을 조사하여 광중합 작용으로 치아(5) 상에서 복합레진부(30)를 경화시켜 고정하는 제4단계(S4); 상기 경화된 돌출부(31)를 연마기로 연마하여 치아(5)의 표면과 수평선상 일치되도록 하면서 광택처리하는 제5단계(S5); 상기 연마된 복합레진부(30) 상에 코팅제를 도포하여 코팅층(60)을 형성하는 제6단계(S6);를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: DENTIROAD CO LTD;HAN HUN SUB;NOH KWAN TAE;PARK YEONG DAE

title_en: Modular design, prefabrication and construction method of emergency shelter hospital infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modular design and prefabrication and construction method of emergency shelter hospital infrastructure; the system comprises an air-conditioning heating and ventilating system, a water supply and drainage system, a medical oxygen system, a power distribution system and an intelligent information system; the method comprises the steps of carrying out modular modeling and unique code assigning on basic functional units of a cabin body of the emergency mobile hospital and standard basic components in a matched support system through BIM digitization and visual design technologies to form a unit module library, calling and assembling modules according to project design requirements when a project is implemented, generating professional construction drawings with positioning base points and module codes after project model building is completed and collision check and optimization design of professional pipelines, and simultaneously transmitting BIM module information data to a PDM product manufacturing database of a manufacturer through BIM and PDM information interfaces to carry out basic unit module prefabrication production, so that the aims of rapid design, standardized manufacturing and efficient deployment of the emergency mobile shelter hospital are fulfilled.
assignees: YUNNAN BUILDING INDUSTRIALIZATION RES AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: A system for performing service steering using real-time triggering in the event of a major disaster and a terminal therefor
title_ko: 실시간 트리거링을 활용한 서비스 스티어링을 수행하기 위한 시스템 및 이를 위한 단말
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for performing service steering comprises: a base station configured to report the number of simultaneous access terminals when a terminal attempts a first type of voice service connection; and a steering device configured to determine whether the number of simultaneous access terminals exceeds a threshold value of a maximum accommodation capacity criterion set according to a steering scenario and configured to transmit a fallback triggering request message to the base station to trigger a fallback procedure for providing a second type of voice service connection when the threshold value is exceeded as a determination result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 서비스 스티어링을 수행하기 위한 시스템은 단말이 제1 종의 음성 서비스 연결을 시도하면, 동시 접속 단말의 수를 리포트하는 기지국과, 상기 동시 접속 단말의 수가 스티어링 시나리오에 따라 설정된 최대 수용 용량 기준의 임계치를 초과하는지 여부를 판별하고, 상기 판별 결과, 상기 임계치를 초과하면, 제2 종의 음성 서비스 연결을 제공하는 폴백 프로시저를 트리거하도록 하는 폴백트리거링요청 메시지를 상기 기지국으로 전달하는 스티어링장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Assembled passageway in sanitary passing area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembled passage in a sanitary passing area, which belongs to the technical field of emergency construction of shelter hospitals for new coronary pneumonia and comprises an assembled passage and a matched finished product passing ramp, wherein the assembled passage consists of a column foundation, a column, a main keel, a secondary keel, a platform plate, a ramp plate, steps and a railing. The emergency storage is made for meeting the emergency requirements of emergency shelter hospital construction, the assembly concept is fully utilized, local materials are obtained on the traditional construction site, a channel with steps, slopes and railings is manufactured, the emergency storage device is used daily, emergency deployment is carried out to shelter hospital sites during epidemic situations, the emergency storage device is directly utilized, the emergency storage device is efficient and convenient, when the size of a transport vehicle is large, the railings are pulled downwards, the moving slopes extend out of the assembly channel, the transport of the transport vehicle cannot be influenced by the railings, the transport vehicle can be conveniently opposite to a transport door under the action of the moving slopes, and the practicability of the emergency storage device is improved.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION 3RD ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Gas Leak And Fire Detection System
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas leak and fire detection system, wherein both gas leak and a fire are detected and transmitted to a terminal. The gas leak and fire detection system comprises: a danger detection device including a housing part having a plurality of bored holes formed on an outer side surface and having an accommodation space formed therein, an acoustic sensor module installed inside the housing part to measure the outer frequency of outer sound introduced through the bored holes, a camera module installed inside the housing part to photograph the outside of the housing part, a memory module having at least one set frequency stored therein and installed inside the housing part, an acoustic camera part installed inside the housing part and including a control signal output module for matching the set frequency stored in the memory module with the outer frequency of the outer sound measured by the acoustic sensor module and outputting a danger signal if a matching value is equal to or greater than a reference matching value, and a flame detection part including a flame sensor module installed inside the housing part to detect the wavelength of a flame generated outside the housing part and to output the waveform of current corresponding to the detected wavelength, a flame waveform storage module having at least one flame reference waveform stored therein and installed inside the housing part, and a fire determining module installed inside the housing part, matching the waveform of current output from the flame sensor module with the flame reference waveform stored in the flame waveform storage module, and outputting a fire signal when a matching value is equal to or greater than a reference matching value; and a monitoring device for outputting images photographed by the camera module. Therefore, gas leak from a pipe can be detected accurately by detecting the sound of the gas leak.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가스 누출과 화재 발생을 모두 감지하여 단말기에 전송하는 가스누출 및 화재발생 감지시스템이다. 이러한 가스누출 및 화재발생 감지시스템은 외측면에 복수 개의 타공홀이 형성되고 내부에 수용공간이 형성된 하우징부, 하우징부의 내부에 설치되어 타공홀을 통해 유입된 외부 소리의 외부주파수를 측정하는 음향센서모듈과, 하우징부의 내부에 설치되어 하우징부의 외부를 촬영하는 카메라모듈과, 적어도 하나의 설정주파수가 저장되어 하우징부의 내부에 설치된 메모리모듈과, 하우징부의 내부에 설치되어 메모리모듈에 저장되어 있는 설정주파수와 음향센서모듈에서 측정된 외부 소리의 외부주파수를 매칭하여 매칭값이 기준매칭값 이상이면 위험신호를 출력하는 제어신호출력모듈이 구비된 음향카메라부 그리고 하우징부의 내부에 설치되어 하우징부의 외부에서 발생된 불꽃의 파장을 감지하여 감지한 파장에 대응하는 전류파형을 출력하는 불꽃센서모듈과, 적어도 하나의 불꽃기준파형이 저장되어 하우징부의 내부에 설치된 불꽃파형저장모듈과, 하우징부의 내부에 설치되어 불꽃센서모듈에서 출력되는 전류파형과 불꽃파형저장모듈에 저장되어 있는 불꽃기준파형을 매칭시켜 매칭값이 기준매칭값 이상 일 때, 화재신호를 출력하는 화재판별모듈이 구비된 불꽃감지부를 포함하는 위험감지장치; 및 카메라모듈에서 촬영된 영상을 출력하는 모니터링장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Shelter allocation device, shelter allocation method, and program
abstract_en: This shelter allocation device comprises: a first acquisition unit configured to acquire an estimate of the time at which each victim will go back home when a disaster occurs; a second acquisition unit configured to acquire the location of each victim for each time interval from the time of the disaster; and an allocation unit configured to, for each time interval and on the basis of the location of each victim as obtained for the time interval and the locations of a plurality of shelters, solve an integer programming problem that aims to minimize the sum of the cost for each victim to move to an opened shelter without exceeding the capacity of the shelter and an operating cost based on the time spent by each victim in each shelter during the time interval, and thereby obtain the result of allocating each victim to a shelter for the time interval. Thus the shelter allocation device makes it possible to allocate shelters taking into account the period during which victims use the shelters.

title_en: Damping expansion joint structure of high-intensity area inland river overhead vertical frame wharf
abstract_en: The invention provides a damping expansion joint structure of an overhead vertical frame wharf in a river in a high-intensity area, which comprises elastic filling materials filled in expansion joints between adjacent cantilever beams, wherein the elastic filling materials can effectively provide an expanded displacement deformation space for the adjacent cantilever beams; a rigid joint-crossing plate is arranged below the elastic filler; the anti-damage device comprises a seam crossing plate, a cantilever beam, a sliding rail, a turntable, pulleys, a movable part of the turntable, and a movable pulley, wherein an anti-damage interval is arranged between the seam crossing plate and the cantilever beam, the bottom of the cantilever beam is provided with the sliding rail, the turntable is fixedly arranged on the seam crossing plate, and the pulley which is matched with the seam crossing plate in a moving way is arranged on the turning movable part of the turntable, so that an anti-damage state which can be universally displaced is formed under the action of an earthquake. According to the invention, by using the high-strength elastic filler as the filler of the expansion joint, not only can damping be formed to provide good shock absorption performance for the wharf structure, but also the influence of earthquake action on the wharf structure can be greatly reduced.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;ZHEJIANG HUADONG ENGINEERING CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT CO LTD

title_en: Compensation type sealing structure for fire-fighting spray header
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a compensation formula seal structure for fire sprinkler head, including seal gasket, sealing member and reference column, seal gasket is metal gasket, and seal gasket includes sealing and supporting part, and the sealing member is provided with the accommodation space that supplies the sealing to place, and the sealing sets up in the accommodation space. The sealing gasket is not easy to shift because the accommodating space of the sealing element surrounds the sealing part of the sealing gasket; the metal elastic sealing gasket is in a bowl-shaped or dish-shaped structure and is matched with the sealing element, so that the compensation capability is stronger, the elasticity can be kept under the conditions of long-time sealing and unstable water pressure, and the situations of water seepage and water leakage are avoided after long-time work; the utility model provides the high yield with the shower nozzle assembly to make and ensure that shower nozzle performance is stable, durable, safe and reliable, start nimble adhesion-free phenomenon and reduction in manufacturing cost.

title_en: Amphibious emergency rescue vehicle for sudden dangerous situations
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of river emergency rescue, in particular to an amphibious emergency rescue vehicle which comprises a vehicle body, a traveling gear train, a power device and a rescue system. The travelling wheel system is used for supporting a vehicle body and is composed of at least 4 travelling tires. The power device is loaded by the vehicle body and is matched with the travelling wheel system. The rescue system is also borne by the vehicle body and comprises a deployable rescue frame. The amphibious emergency rescue vehicle has the functions of land rescue and water surface rescue. When an emergency happens, the power device is started, each walking tire continuously rotates circumferentially under the action of input power until the vehicle body is displaced to the shore of the scene to be rescued, or after the amphibious emergency rescue vehicle enters water, the amphibious emergency rescue vehicle also sails to the water area to be rescued under the action of the driving force of the power device, and then the rescue frame can be unfolded to execute stretching action, so that rescue workers can approach the person or object to be rescued.

title_en: Windproof and shockproof temporary housing for municipal house building engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a windproof and shockproof temporary housing for municipal house construction engineering, which relates to the technical field of temporary buildings and comprises a house main body, wherein the outer side of the house main body is of a cambered surface structure, and the diameter of the house main body is gradually increased from top to bottom; the house main body comprises mounting panel, fossil fragments frame, polylith house board, roof, fossil fragments frame fixed mounting is in the top of mounting panel, the polylith the circumference fixed mounting of house board is in the inside of fossil fragments frame, roof fixed mounting is in the polylith the top of house board. The house main body of the cambered surface structure has good wind resistance, so that air flow can flow through the surface of the house quickly, wind resistance can be effectively reduced, the pressure born by the steel structure is reduced, and the house is more stable in typhoon weather; the stabilizing component can stably connect the mounting plate with the ground, so that the shockproof capacity of the house main body is increased, the shock absorbing component can reduce the shock suffered by the house main body, and the shockproof capacity of the house main body is improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY SIGNAL & COMMUNICATION SHANGHAI ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System for providing seasonal worker total management service
title_ko: 외국인 계절근로자 통합관리 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for providing an integrated management service for a seasonal foreign worker. A server for providing an integrated management service includes: a worker terminal receiving a job hunting matching result after setting a jot matching condition including a career and a desired condition; a user terminal uploading business place information and a confirmation of an employer who is an object of seasonal worker arrangement, and assigned with a worker according to a predetermined assignment method when a document satisfying a criterion of an accommodation according to a basic plane of a seasonal worker program is issued; a receipt unit determining issuing of the document according to whether the criterion of the accommodation is satisfied, and receiving a job offer matching condition from the user terminal and an administrative agency terminal managing the user and the worker of the user terminal and the worker terminal; a business place management unit receiving the upload of the business place information and the confirmation of the employer who is the object of seasonal worker arrangement from the user terminal and storing the same; a registration unit registering a business place of the user terminal as an accommodation condition satisfaction business place in case of issuing the document satisfying the criterion of the accommodation by the administrative agency terminal; a matching unit performing matching by receiving the registration of the job hunting matching condition and the job offer matching condition from the worker terminal and the user terminal; and an assignment unit registering the worker in the business place when the worker of the worker terminal is assigned to the business place of the user terminal by the administrative agency terminal. The system for providing an integrated management service for a seasonal foreigner worker manages a business place change or leaving the business place of the worker and shares the document with an involved agency server when an administrative agency sets an involved agency.
abstract_ko: 외국인 계절근로자 통합관리 서비스 제공 시스템이 제공되며, 경력 및 희망조건을 포함하는 구직매칭요건을 설정한 후 구직매칭결과를 수신하는 근로자 단말, 사업장 정보 및 계절근로자 배치대상 고용주 확인서를 업로드하고, 계절근로자 프로그램 기본계획에 따른 숙소의 기준을 만족하는 서류를 발급받은 경우, 기 설정된 배정방식에 따라 근로자를 배정받는 사용자 단말, 숙소의 기준을 만족하는지의 여부에 따라 서류의 발급여부를 결정하며, 근로자 단말 및 사용자 단말의 근로자 및 사용자를 관리하는 행정기관 단말 및 사용자 단말로부터 구인매칭요건을 설정받는 접수부, 사용자 단말로부터 사업장 정보 및 계절근로자 배치대상 고용주 확인서를 업로드받아 저장하는 사업장관리부, 행정기관 단말에서 숙소의 기준을 만족하는 서류를 발급하는 경우 사용자 단말의 사업장을 숙소조건충족 사업장으로 등록하는 등록부, 근로자 단말 및 사용자 단말로부터 구직매칭요건 및 구인매칭요건을 등록받아 매칭을 실시하는 매칭부, 행정기관 단말에서 근로자 단말의 근로자를 사용자 단말의 사업장에 배치하는 경우 근로자를 사업장에 등록하는 배정부를 포함하는 통합관리 서비스 제공 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Limiting anti-seismic device for middle-span and small-span continuous beam bridge
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of buildings, and particularly discloses a medium-span and small-span continuous beam bridge limiting anti-seismic device which is arranged between a main beam and a non-braking pier and comprises a support cushion stone, a first stop block, a rubber block and a second stop block; the support cushion stone is fixedly arranged at the top of the non-braking bridge pier, and a movable support is arranged between the support cushion stone and the main beam; the first stop block is fixed at the top of the non-braking bridge pier and is arranged at the side end of the support cushion stone, and a inhaul cable is connected between the rubber block and the support cushion stone; the bottom of locating the girder is fixed to the second dog, is connected with the spring between second dog and the rubber piece, and the spring makes the rubber piece have along the trend that the bridge moved to the second dog all the time, forms accommodation gap between second dog and the first dog. The utility model solves the defect that the continuous beam can not participate in the forward bridge anti-seismic together under the earthquake working condition, improves the anti-seismic capacity of the bridge, and can avoid the defect that the continuous rigid frame receives larger forward bridge bending moment under the normal working condition.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INST

title_en: Data processing method and device for garbage point area
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method and device for a garbage point area, and relates to the technical field of electric digital data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring first weight change data of a first garbage point and monitoring second weight change data of a second garbage point; if the first weight change data and the second weight change data are in an abnormal change state, acquiring first image data and acquiring second image data; determining target object data according to the first image data and the second image data, determining first garbage falling data according to the first image data, and determining second garbage falling data according to the second image data; determining a target destruction coefficient of the target object according to the first weight change data, the second weight change data, the first garbage drop data, the second garbage drop data and the target object data; and determining the accommodation priority and the target accommodation policy of the target object according to the target destruction coefficient, wherein the calculation overhead is low and the living experience of people can be improved.
assignees: JIANGXI ZONJLI HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban space region suitability evaluation method, system and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city space region suitability evaluation method, a system and a terminal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining urban comprehensive index data, uniformly dividing urban space into a plurality of urban grids, and calculating urban population accommodation capacity of each urban grid according to the urban comprehensive index; obtaining street view image data of each city grid, and respectively obtaining population accommodation amount predicted values of each city grid according to population accommodation amounts of all cities and all street view image data; acquiring mobile phone signaling data, and calculating population estimation of each urban grid according to the mobile phone signaling data; and respectively calculating suitability indexes of each urban grid according to the predicted value of each people mouth accommodation amount and the corresponding estimated value of each people mouth, and finishing urban space region suitability evaluation of each urban grid according to each suitability index. The invention realizes fine suitability evaluation and provides innovative theoretical basis and technical support for constructing more accurate urban structures and realizing efficient traveling of residents.

title_en: Stable bridge anti-seismic support
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of bridge earthquake resistance and bridge earthquake reduction and isolation application, and particularly discloses a stable bridge earthquake-resistant support. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: 1. the T-shaped guide rail is fixedly arranged on the connecting plate and is matched with the T-shaped chute at the bottom of the cover plate, the T-shaped guide rail can slide in the T-shaped chute 12, and when the beam body is transversely displaced, the T-shaped guide rail can be extruded to the T-shaped limiting block in the sliding process, so that the transverse displacement of the beam body can be buffered, and the energy of the earthquake transverse wave can be absorbed; 2. the upper part of the base is provided with a cylindrical groove matched with the wall surface of the vibration absorbing cushion block, and the bottom surface of the cylindrical groove is fixedly provided with a high-strength spring, so that the buffer effect on the longitudinal displacement of the beam body can be effectively realized, and the longitudinal wave energy is absorbed.

title_en: Evacuation plan creation method, evacuation plan creation device and program
abstract_en: To provide a method of creating an evacuation plan of selecting an evacuation destination to which a user can surely evacuate by considering the accommodation capacity of the evacuation destination and difficulty of evacuation.SOLUTION: An evacuation plan creation method comprises the steps of: setting a first zone that is the most dangerous, a second zone that is the temporary evacuation destination and a third zone that is the final evacuation destination; setting evacuees who stay in the first zone to the third zone; setting a support resource used for movement support between the zones; and calculating the evacuees and the support resource moving from the first zone to the second zone, the evacuees and the support resource moving from the first zone to the third zone and the evacuees and the support resource moving from the second zone to the third zone such that an evacuation cost between the respective zones satisfies a constraint condition and satisfies a prescribed evacuation strategy condition.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fire-fighting supervision and inspection device with multipoint positioning information acquisition function and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting supervision and inspection device with multipoint positioning information acquisition function and a use method thereof. According to the invention, the problems that the existing fire supervision and inspection device cannot flexibly adjust the shooting capturing range, cannot acquire and shoot multi-point information, has poor applicability to the external complex environment, does not have the function of anti-theft locking, is easy to be pushed and displaced by other personnel at will, cannot adjust the checking angle and affects the observation comfort of the staff are solved by matching the anti-skid jacket, the guide seat, the movable block, the electric push rod, the connecting rod, the multi-section electric telescopic rod, the guide frame, the mounting frame, the touch screen controller, the RFID reader, the anti-skid hemispherical jack, the cross rod, the connecting sleeve, the anti-skid inserted rod, the camera, the driven gear, the driving gear, the servo motor, the supporting block, the guide post, the movable rod, the connecting frame and the fixed block.

title_en: Crowd evacuation and placement method, equipment, device and medium used in the sunset of storm
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster emergency treatment, in particular to a crowd evacuation and placement method, equipment, a device and a medium before heavy rain, which are based on a digital elevation model to divide a submerged unit of a target area; combining the historical rainfall and the inundation data corresponding to the inundation unit to establish a rainfall inundation model of the inundation unit; acquiring a placement point in a target area; classifying the available placement points based on the data of the available placement points, the medical interest point data of the target area and the road network data; the method and the system can be used for distributing people at the evacuation points to the optimal placement points by combining the accommodation capacity of the placement points and the medical and health resource conditions, so that the emergency evacuation scheme at the beginning of a storm disaster is more reasonable and orderly.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Hot melting type opening method of fire-fighting nozzle and fire-fighting nozzle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hot-melt type opening method of a fire-fighting nozzle and the fire-fighting nozzle, comprising the following steps: in the initial state, the axial connecting piece and the hot melting piece are mutually matched and limit the first core assembly and the second core assembly in the axial direction, so that the plugging assembly is closed by being abutted by the first core assembly; the hot melt piece flows out after being heated and melted, so that the axial limiting distance between the first movement assembly and the second movement assembly is increased; the second movement assembly moves away from the first movement assembly along the axial direction, and the first limiting piece moves outwards in the first through groove so as to release the limiting effect of the first limiting piece on the first limiting part of the first movement assembly; the first core assembly is axially displaced to release interference to the plugging assembly, so that the fire sprinkler is opened for spraying.
assignees: NINGBO ZHURONG FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Municipal drainage well with ponding degree of depth monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ponding depth monitoring equipment, and relates to a municipal drainage well with a ponding depth monitoring function, wherein a main structure comprises a laser ranging device, a gyroscope device, a data wireless transmission device and a controller, and the four parts are matched together, so that the dynamic monitoring of the water level below a well lid can be realized, the intelligent dynamic monitoring of a municipal drainage pipe network is met, the real-time monitoring of possible waterlogging hidden danger points is realized, and after the well lid is displaced, the remote alarm is realized through the data wireless transmission device, so that the real-time monitoring of the well lid state is realized; the intelligent monitoring system has the advantages that the structure is simple, the principle is scientific and reliable, the water accumulation depth and the well lid state in the well can be monitored in real time, the hidden danger of waterlogging can be identified rapidly, an alarm can be sent out timely, the running efficiency and the safety of the urban drainage system can be improved, the occurrence of waterlogging disasters can be reduced, the intelligent monitoring of the municipal drainage well can be realized, and the efficiency and the safety of the drainage system can be improved.
assignees: QINGDAO GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE QINGDAO GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION DEVELOPMENT BUREAU

title_en: Emergency refuge place has sign of LED display screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an identification label with an LED display screen in an emergency shelter, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fixed seat, the upper end of the fixed seat is symmetrically provided with telescopic rods, the sides of the fixed seat are provided with driving motors, one end of each driving motor is provided with a rotating shaft, one end of each rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a second bevel gear, a threaded rod is arranged in the fixed seat, a first bevel gear is arranged outside the threaded rod, a bearing is arranged at the bottom of the fixed seat, the lower end of the threaded rod is mutually matched with the bearing, the outer threads of the threaded rod are connected with thread blocks, push rods are arranged on two sides of the thread blocks, and the upper ends of the two push rods extend to the outside through the upper ends of the fixed seat and are provided with support rods. Through the structure, the push rod can push the vertical plate to move under the cooperation of the threaded rod and the threaded block, so that the height of the signboard is adjusted.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUANANBANG CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Rain and tide disaster emergency risk avoiding path and material allocation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency risk avoidance, in particular to a rain and tide disaster emergency risk avoidance path and material allocation optimization method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting area basic data to construct a rain and tide simulation model, and carrying out submerged result simulation by using the rain and tide simulation model; constructing a mathematical model of the human-vehicle emergency refuge transfer path according to the inundation simulation result and by taking the shortest overall transfer time of population of the disaster area as a target and integrating the safety of the transfer path, the placement capacity of the emergency refuge site and the maximum time consumption constraint; and according to the risk avoiding transfer result, constructing an emergency risk avoiding material allocation model by taking the highest supply degree of personnel materials in the emergency shelter as a total target and integrating the safety of allocation routes and the constraint of maximum allocation time consumption. According to the invention, by combining a rain and tide simulation model, an emergency risk avoiding transfer path mathematical model and an emergency risk avoiding material allocation model and through an intelligent optimization algorithm, the accuracy of risk avoiding transfer and material allocation under a forecast disaster situation is improved.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RES INST PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Digital twin city people flow simulation display method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for simulating and displaying the traffic of a digital twin city, which are applied to the field of data scene simulation; according to the invention, through collecting the pre-recorded people flow data, characteristic parameters of the moving path, density distribution and congestion duration are identified, so that the understanding of population flowing modes and trends is facilitated, the characteristic parameters can reveal population flowing rules and changing trends, important references are provided for planning and management of digital twin cities, meanwhile, a pre-trained prediction model is applied to conduct hot spot prediction on people flow simulation scenes, so that the identification of high-density areas and congestion hot spots of population flowing is facilitated, guidance is provided for management staff, targeted management and adjustment measures are adopted, the preset flexible layout content in the digital twin cities is invoked, the demand adjustment is conducted by applying the flexible layout content and changing design functions, the optimization of space utilization of the preset areas and organization of population flowing is facilitated, and the accommodation capacity and adaptability of the cities are improved.

title_en: Emergent limbs rescue hemostasis equipment of sanitation service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical emergency limb rescue hemostatic device, which relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and comprises a first device body and a second device body, wherein the first device body and the second device body are clamped by a connecting component, the inner wall of the first device body is connected with a plate in a sliding manner, a pressing plate is arranged in the first device body, the top surface of the pressing plate is fixedly connected with a pressing rod, the inner wall of the pressing rod is connected with a limiting rod in a sliding manner, the upper end of the limiting rod is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the first device body, two arc plates are arranged in the pressing plate, two groups of hemostatic components and a matching component are further arranged, the pressing plate can be displaced relatively quickly in the vertical direction through the arrangement of the two groups of hemostatic components, and the two arc plates can follow the displacement in the displacement process of the pressing plate and deflect simultaneously through the mutual matching of the structures.

title_en: Bearing capacity evaluation method and device for emergency shelter and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a bearing capacity evaluation method and device for an emergency shelter and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of bearing capacity evaluation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a bearing capacity evaluation index system of the emergency shelter, and acquiring quantized scores corresponding to the bearing capacity evaluation indexes respectively; based on the bearing capacity evaluation index, a first weighting method is used for obtaining first weights respectively corresponding to the bearing capacity evaluation index; based on the bearing capacity evaluation index, a second weighting method is used for obtaining second weights respectively corresponding to the bearing capacity evaluation index; based on the first weight and the second weight, a combination weighting method is used for obtaining combination weights respectively corresponding to the bearing capacity evaluation indexes; and calculating and obtaining the bearing capacity score of the emergency refuge site based on the quantized scores respectively corresponding to the bearing capacity evaluation indexes and the combination weights respectively corresponding to the bearing capacity evaluation indexes. The accuracy of bearing capacity evaluation can be improved.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Building shock insulation layer is with tensile device of pulling out
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pull-out resistance device for a building shock insulation layer; the anti-pulling device comprises an upper buttress, a lower buttress and an anti-pulling structure, wherein the anti-pulling structure is arranged between the upper buttress and the lower buttress; the pulling-resistant structure comprises a pulling-resistant block arranged between the upper buttress and the lower buttress, and the pulling-resistant block can be displaced between the upper buttress and the lower buttress along the left-right direction or the front-back direction; the tensile pulling structure further comprises two groups of guide components which are arranged in a staggered manner, and the two groups of guide components are respectively used for guiding the left-right direction displacement process and the front-back direction displacement process of the tensile block; and a plurality of pull-resisting rods are pre-buried on the upper buttress and the lower buttress. The pulling-out resistant device provided by the invention can adapt to horizontal deformation and vertical compression deformation of the shock insulation layer, can limit the vertical pulling deformation of the shock insulation layer, solves the problem of small tensile bearing capacity of the shock insulation layer of the shock insulation building, and effectively prevents the building shock insulation layer from being pulled to be damaged under the action of high intensity earthquake.
assignees: YUNNAN ZHUNING DAMPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile disaster prevention refuge place suitable for mountain village
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable disaster prevention refuge site suitable for mountain villages, which comprises a movable platform and an umbrella-shaped expansion assembly connected to the movable platform, wherein the umbrella-shaped expansion assembly comprises a traffic tower column, a grabbing disc anchor knife assembly, umbrella ribs and a hosting platform, the traffic tower column is a multi-stage hydraulic telescopic mechanism, the bottom end of the traffic tower column is connected with the movable platform through a turnover mechanism, the top end of the traffic tower column is connected with one end of the umbrella ribs through a hinge assembly to form an umbrella-shaped structure, the other end of the umbrella ribs is connected with the ground through the grabbing disc anchor knife assembly to be straight, the hosting platform is connected between the traffic tower column and the umbrella ribs and is used for bearing refuge personnel, and the hosting platform is built in multiple layers along the axial direction of the traffic tower column; according to the invention, the telescopic multi-layer type accommodation platform is formed in the vertical space through the movable platform and the umbrella-shaped expansion assembly, so that the purposes of enhancing the space stability of the refuge site and expanding the space capacity of the refuge site accommodation space are realized, and the refuge site accommodation space is used for personnel to carry out refuge accommodation.

title_en: Multifunctional transportation back box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional transportation back box, wherein the bottoms of side plates are connected with the periphery of a bottom plate through foldable buckles to form a box body, two detachable braces which are connected up and down are arranged on the side plate at the front side of the box body, and universal wheels are arranged at the bottoms of the front side of the bottom plate and the tops of the side plates at the rear side of the box body; a handle is arranged at the top of the side plate at the front side of the box body; a soft cushion layer is arranged outside the side plate at the front side of the box body and is formed by folding tent cloth; the inside wear-resisting string that is equipped with of braces, wear-resisting string fills braces inner space and sets up the shackle at the afterbody. The invention forms the box body through the combination of the bottom plate and the side plate, and can be used for transporting fire-fighting tools; the side plates are unfolded and matched with the universal wheels to form a transport vehicle, so that the articles can be conveniently transported; the side plates are disassembled and then are buckled with the foldable buckles to form a tent frame, and tent cloth is covered to form a tent, so that long-time outdoor operation accommodation is facilitated; the wear-resistant string in the harness can be taken out for binding objects.

title_en: Accommodation ladder is stepped on to lifeboat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifeboat boarding accommodation ladder, which comprises a vertical ladder assembly and an inclined ladder assembly, wherein the vertical ladder assembly comprises two vertical ladder side frames, a plurality of sliding grooves distributed in a linear array are formed in one side wall, close to each other, of each vertical ladder side frame, a plurality of self-lifting assemblies distributed in a linear array are connected in a sliding manner in the sliding grooves of the two vertical ladder side frames, and each self-lifting assembly comprises a connecting sliding plate, two pressing plates, two connecting contacts, two lifting springs, a plurality of decelerating contacts, a plurality of decelerating springs and two fixing plates. The utility model solves the problem that the traditional ladder needs to climb step by step when in use, and the lifting spring is matched with the engagement slide plate which can actively descend by the weight of the evacuee to climb downwards, so that the problem of low rescue efficiency caused by low climbing speed of the evacuee in a bumpy environment is avoided, and the speed reduction spring can reduce the speed when the evacuee is close to the descending bottom, thereby ensuring the safety of the evacuee.
assignees: SHANGHAI YANTU SHIP MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire control pipeline mounting bracket for fire engineering
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of fire-fighting pipeline installation, and discloses a fire-fighting pipeline installation rack for fire-fighting engineering, which comprises a fixed bracket, wherein a pipeline main body is installed at the inner edge of the fixed bracket, fixed plates are fixedly installed at the bottoms of the front end and the rear end of the fixed bracket, first installation seats are fixedly connected to the middle parts of the two sides of the fixed plates, a movable supporting rod is rotatably installed at the middle part of one end of the inner wall of the first installation seat, a movable sleeve is sleeved on one side of the outer surface of the movable supporting rod, a spring is installed in the movable sleeve, and a second installation seat is movably installed at the top part of one side of the outer surface of the movable sleeve; according to the application, the movable support rod is matched with the movable sleeve to support the fixed support in an inclined manner, so that the effect of conveniently preventing the whole pipeline main body from being horizontally displaced is achieved, the whole stable supporting effect of the fixed support on the pipeline main body is improved, the problem that the fixed support is driven to loosen by horizontal displacement after the pipeline main body is used for a certain time is solved, and the whole installation effect of the pipeline main body is improved.
assignees: ANHUI CHENGRUI FIRE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Emergency shelter car with conveniently get on or off car function
abstract_en: The utility model provides an emergency shelter car with a convenient getting-on and getting-off function, which comprises a shelter body, wherein the shelter body is arranged on a car frame, a storage groove is formed in the bottom of the shelter body, a frame is arranged in the storage groove, a rotating seat is in locking connection with the extending end of a second electric push rod through a fixing bolt, then the second electric push rod drives the frame to turn upwards, after a pedal plate is kept parallel to the frame, a wounded person can be sent to a shelter door in a lifting mode through a platform surface, and then is sent into the shelter by being matched with medical staff.

title_en: Relief Supplies Distribution System in Relief Station
abstract_en: One aspect of the present invention relates to a material distribution system of a relief center and, more specifically, to a material distribution system of a relief center, capable of properly distributing materials to each of a plurality of relief centers from a material storage center when a disaster situation occurs, and in some cases, properly distributing materials between the plurality of relief centers so that the materials are efficiently distributed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a material distribution system capable of properly distributing disaster materials from a material storage center to a relief center. In addition, according to another embodiment of the present invention, when a plurality of relief centers are installed, the system can effectively distribute the disaster materials between the relief centers. In particular, provided is a material distribution system which implements effective redistribution of victims and relief materials when a difference in risk level occurs between the relief centers depending on a disaster environment and a relief center with a high risk level is closed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일 측면은 구호소의 물자 배분 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 상황이 발생시 물자보관소에서 복수의 구호소 각각에 적절하게 물자 배분이 수행되고, 경우에 따라서 복수의 구호소 상호 간에 적절하게 물자 배분이 수행되어 물자의 효율적인 분배가 이루어지도록 하는 구호소의 물자 배분 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면 물자보관소에서 구호소로 재해물자 배분이 적절하게 이루어지도록 하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 다른 실시예에 따르면 복수의 구호소가 설치된 경우, 구호소 상호 간에 재해물자의 배분이 효과적으로 이루어지도록 하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 특히, 재난환경에 따라서 분포된 구호소 간에 위험등급에 차이가 생기고, 위험등급이 높은 구호소가 폐쇄되는 경우, 이재민 및 구호물자의 효과적인 재분배를 구현하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus, maintenance method, and recording medium
title_ko: 기판 처리 장치, 보수 방법 및 기억 매체
abstract_en: The objective is to improve the safety of a worker during maintenance work on a substrate processing apparatus. The substrate processing apparatus processes substrates and comprises: a housing with an accommodation space for devices used in processing substrates; an opening and closing device which switches between open and closed states of the accommodation space; a detection unit installed around the housing to detect worker-protection gear; and a control unit which controls the operation of the opening and closing device. The control unit determines whether the protection gear detected by the detection unit matches pre-registered corresponding protection gear for the housing, and executes control to switch the accommodation space from a closed state to an open state when the protection gear corresponds to the registered protection gear.
abstract_ko:
[과제] 기판 처리 장치의 보수 작업 시에서의 작업자의 안전성을 향상시킨다.  
[해결 수단] 기판을 처리하는 기판 처리 장치로서, 상기 기판의 처리를 위해서 사용되는 기기를 수용하는 수용 공간을 가진 하우징과, 상기 수용 공간의 열림 상태와 닫힘 상태를 전환하는 개폐기와, 상기 하우징의 주변에 설치되어, 작업자의 착용 보호구를 검지하는 검지부와, 상기 개폐기의 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 구비하고, 상기 제어부는, 상기 검지부에 의해 검지된 상기 착용 보호구가 미리 등록된 상기 하우징에 대응하는 대응 보호구인지 판정을 행하여, 상기 착용 보호구가 상기 대응 보호구인 경우에는, 상기 수용 공간의 닫힘 상태를 열림 상태로 전환하는 제어를 실행한다.

title_en: Apparatus for simulating patient flow using machine learning-based predictive model for critical illness and method thereof
title_ko: 중증확률 예측 모델을 이용한 환자흐름 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a patient flow simulation apparatus using a severe probability prediction model and a method thereof. According to the present invention, a patient flow simulation device using a severe probability prediction model comprises: a clinical information collection unit for collecting clinical information on a plurality of patients; a dataset generation unit for classifying the collected clinical information into a plurality of groups according to the main symptoms of the patient and acquiring a dataset from the plurality of classified groups; a model construction unit for estimating importance according to a predictor using the dataset and constructing a severe probability prediction model for predicting a severe probability using the estimated importance of the predictor; a prediction unit for acquiring clinical information of a patient in which an emergency situation occurs, and inputting the acquired clinical information into a pre-constructed severe probability prediction model to predict the severe probability of the corresponding patient; and a simulation unit for acquiring information on emergency patient distribution and emergency patient accommodation capacity of a medical institution in real time, and determining a transfer path of the corresponding patient according to the predicted severe probability.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 중증확률 예측 모델을 이용한 환자흐름 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 중증확률 예측 모델을 이용한 환자흐름 시뮬레이션 장치는 복수의 환자에 대한 임상 정보를 수집하는 임상 정보 수집부, 수집된 임상 정보를 환자의 주증상에 따라 복수개의 그룹으로 분류하고, 분류된 복수개의 그룹으로부터 데이터 셋을 획득하는 데이터셋 생성부, 데이터 셋을 이용하여 예측 변수에 따른 중요도를 추정하고, 추정된 예측 변수의 중요도를 이용하여 중증 확률을 예측하도록 하는 중증 확률 예측 모델을 구축하는 모델 구축부, 응급 상황이 발생된 환자의 임상 정보를 획득하고, 획득한 임상 정보를 기 구축된 중증 확률 예측 모델에 입력하여 해당되는 환자의 중증 확률을 예측하는 예측부, 그리고 응급환자 분포, 의료기관의 응급환자 수용 능력에 대한 정보를 실시간으로 획득하고, 예측된 중증 확률에 따라 해당되는 환자의 이송 경로를 결정하는 시뮬레이션부를 포함한다.

title_en: Assessment method, device and medium for service capacity of emergency shelter
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assessment method, device and medium for service capacity of an emergency shelter, which comprise the steps of calculating a service area set accessible to walking of various emergency shelters based on basic data of the various emergency shelters, carrying out space superposition on the service area set and a construction land range to obtain a land area of the emergency shelter for covering an area to be assessed, and calculating population proportion of the various emergency shelters in the area to be assessed according to population density and the land area of the area to be assessed to obtain assessment results of the various emergency shelters in the area to be assessed. The invention provides an assessment method, device and medium for service capacity of an emergency shelter, which are used for reasonably calculating walking accessibility, accurately carrying out space superposition analysis and fully considering population density differences to calculate and obtain assessment results of various emergency shelters, so that the problem that the service capacity of the emergency shelter is difficult to accurately assess can be solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TRANSP PLANNING RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Global travel industry monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The system comprises a data monitoring unit, a resource allocation unit and a background monitoring unit, wherein the resource allocation unit comprises a resource evaluation module, a people flow identification module, an emergency response module, a resource scheduling module and an analog simulation module, the resource scheduling module is connected with the analog simulation module in a one-way manner, key resources such as vehicles, accommodation facilities and catering services in scenic spots are comprehensively and carefully evaluated through the resource evaluation module, the utilization efficiency of various resources and the matching degree of tourist demands are deeply analyzed, the system can monitor and predict the change of the people flow in the scenic spots in real time, so that various resources are intelligently scheduled, and the intelligent resource scheduling mode not only improves the utilization efficiency of the resources, reduces the operation cost, but also greatly improves the tourist experience and satisfaction.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG SUNXINGZHE TOURISM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Aluminum-clad steel fire-resistant window capable of avoiding fire spreading
