abstract_en: The utility model provides an aluminum-clad steel fire-resistant window capable of avoiding fire spreading, which relates to the technical field of fire-resistant windows and comprises a window frame and window sashes, wherein an aluminum layer is wrapped on the front surface of the window frame, a fireproof plate is arranged on the front surface of the window frame, sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the front surface of the window frame, sliding pieces are arranged on two sides of the back surface of the fireproof plate and are matched with the sliding grooves, a movable cavity is formed in the window frame, clamping plates are embedded in the movable cavity, clamping grooves are formed in the back surface of the fireproof plate, the clamping plates are mutually clamped with the clamping grooves, a smoke alarm is arranged in a front mounting opening of the window frame, the front surface of the window frame can be displaced when a fire disaster occurs, and therefore the window frame can be sealed by the fireproof plate when the fire disaster occurs, and the fire spreading can be effectively avoided.
assignees: HAINAN PAICHENG ALUMINUM INDUSTRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Total information processing system customized for foreign seasonal workers and method therefor
title_ko: 외국인계절근로자 맞춤형 종합 정보처리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a comprehensive information processing system customized to a foreign seasonal worker that processes information necessary for each business participant (for example, a local government, a hiring business owner, and a foreigner) to notify, receive, and analyze and process various data. The comprehensive information processing system customized to the foreign seasonal worker comprises: a hiring business owner terminal that registers a business registration certificate, a facility status, accommodation costs, the number of applicants for foreign seasonal workers, and working conditions; a foreign seasonal worker terminal; a local government system; and an information processing system that analyzes the status of the registered hiring business owner to provide information regarding whether the hiring business owner is eligible, services so as to automatically register the foreign seasonal worker information on the hiring business owner my page, and issues an electronic work contract to the hiring business owner terminal and the foreign seasonal worker terminal. According to the present invention, information necessary for the foreign seasonal worker business is collected in a single foreign seasonal worker-customized comprehensive information processing system to minimize limitations of geographical locations of the local government, the hiring business owner, and the foreign seasonal worker, information processing cost or time, and the administrative cost and the like.
abstract_ko: 외국인계절근로자 운영을 위해 필요한 각종 정보를 수집 및 취합하여 각 사업자참여자(지자체, 채용 사업주, 외국인) 필요한 정보를 처리하여 알림, 접수, 각종 데이터 분석 및 가공하는 외국인계절근로자 맞춤형 종합 정보처리 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 외국인계절근로자 맞춤형 종합 정보처리 시스템은, 사업자등록증, 시설현황, 숙박비, 외국인계절근로자 신청인원 및 근로조건을 등록하는 채용 사업주 단말; 외국인계절근로자 단말; 지자체 시스템; 및 (i) 상기 채용 사업주 단말을 통해 요청되는 외국인계절근로자 초청 채용 사업주의 자격요건을 확인하여, 등록된 채용 사업주 현황을 분석하여 해당 채용 사업주의 적격여부에 대한 정보를 제공하고, (ii) 상기 지자체 시스템의 외국인계절근로자 참여 승인 여부를 상기 채용 사업주 단말에 통지 알림 처리하고, 상기 지자체 시스템이 채용 사업주에 매칭된 외국인계절근로자 정보를 채용 사업주 마이페이지에 자동 등록하게 하도록 서비스하고, (iii) 채용 사업주와 외국인계절근로자간의 체결된 전자근로계약서를 상기 채용 사업주 단말과 상기 외국인계절근로자 단말에 교부하는 정보처리 시스템을 포함한다.

title_en: Method for analyzing management and control data of non-custody and management and control platform
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data processing, and particularly provides a method for analyzing and controlling non-friedel management and control data and a management and control platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively extracting characteristics of all non-friedel monitoring data subsets to obtain corresponding overall vector representation and detail vector representation, and simplifying according to vector space similarity to obtain an overall vector representation combination and detail vector representation combination with set accommodation capacity; the method comprises the steps of merging a total search vector representation and a detail search vector representation which are obtained through pre-learning, extracting through an internal weight focusing strategy to obtain a corresponding internal weight focusing vector representation, extracting a first cross-domain weight focusing vector representation and a second cross-domain weight focusing vector representation through a cross-domain weight focusing strategy, and determining a non-friendship performance recognition result according to each first cross-domain weight focusing vector representation and each second cross-domain weight focusing vector representation. The application can improve the accuracy and efficiency of identifying the non-custody performance identification result.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHONGHE YUESHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency facility site selection and service optimization model under facility failure and traffic jam conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency facility site selection and service optimization model under the condition of facility failure and traffic jam, which relates to the technical field of comprehensive facility site selection, wherein a pre-disaster planning decision model F  1  is used for site selection decision of an emergency shelter and multi-stage service allocation decision with priority, a dynamic optimization model F  2  under the condition of failure of the post-disaster emergency shelter is used for reallocating services between temporary rescue points and the shelter and route adjustment of self-evacuation crowd under the condition of user balance UE, and a double-layer mixed integer nonlinear planning model MINLP based on a priority service allocation relation is formed by the pre-disaster planning decision model F  1  and a dynamic optimization model F  2  under the condition of failure of the post-disaster emergency shelter, and an equivalent single-layer mixed integer nonlinear planning model is deduced according to KKT conditions, wherein the single-layer mixed integer nonlinear planning model comprises a necessary condition and a sufficient condition that the flow value of a UE road section in the dynamic optimization model F  2  under the condition of failure of the post-disaster emergency shelter.

title_en: Emergency shelter crowd guiding device and method based on fusion positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for guiding crowd in an emergency shelter based on fusion positioning, and relates to the technical field of visible light, wherein the device comprises an optical information control assembly and a positioning guide assembly, the optical information control assembly comprises a light control unit, and the positioning guide assembly comprises an optical information receiving module, an optical information position analyzing module and a guide information display and control module; the system comprises a light control unit for controlling high-frequency flicker of lamplight, a light information receiving module for receiving the light signals, a light information position analyzing module for analyzing the light signals to obtain positioning data, fingerprint matching the positioning data by a fingerprint positioning method to obtain position data, and a guide information display control module for displaying the position data on a pre-constructed map model. The present invention allows for accurate positioning on the order of centimeters in an underground environment without satellite signals by combining VLP technology with MEMS sensors.
assignees: NO 15 INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Evacuation System
abstract_en: To obtain an evacuation system that can increase practicality of an evacuation shelter operations manual.SOLUTION: There is provided an evacuation system in which an evacuation shelter operations manual when a disaster occurs is digitized and which is equipped with a mobile terminal capable of using application software that is utilized during an actual evacuation and evacuation drill when a disaster occurs. The mobile terminal starts up or logs into the application software when implementing an actual evacuation or evacuation drill, thereby executes a function of sequentially displaying actions that each person should take at the evacuation shelter in accordance with their assigned roles, and a function of enabling to add items to be corrected as a memo by operation inputs from the mobile terminal at a time of noticing any items to be corrected of displayed contents on each screen that is sequentially displayed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Movable telescopic disaster relief medical micro-building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable telescopic disaster relief medical micro-building, which comprises a base, wherein the inside of the base is arranged in a telescopic and expandable extension mechanism, the top of the base is provided with a sliding mechanism for supporting and sliding the extension mechanism, the bottom of the base is provided with a movable and adjustable displacement mechanism, the extension mechanism comprises a driving component, a transmission component, an expansion component and a connecting component, the invention realizes the expansion and the increase of the actual use area in the micro-building according to the telescopic mode through the matching arrangement of the extension mechanism and the sliding mechanism, not only can be adjusted according to the requirement, but also can accommodate more disaster affected people and supplies, improves the accommodation property in disaster relief, and utilizes the extension mechanism to extend and adjust the original accommodation space to the outside so as to facilitate the increase of the accommodation space, but also facilitates the extension mechanism to assist the sliding in the outward extension adjustment so as to ensure the stability in extension.
assignees: AFFILIATED STOMATOLOGICAL HOSPITAL OF NANCHANG UNIV JIANGXI PROVINCIAL STOMATOLOGICAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Frame construction post muscle displacement correcting unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a correction device, which belongs to the technical field of column ribs of a frame structure, in particular to a displacement correction device for the column ribs of the frame structure, comprising a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a plurality of steel bars; according to the utility model, constructors respectively carry out threaded connection on the threaded rods in four directions of the connecting frame, the threaded rods can move inwards through the cooperation with the internal threads, the limiting frame is driven to be positioned on one side of the steel bar, meanwhile, the steel bar can be bonded and limited through the arc-shaped blocks, the limiting frame and the arc-shaped blocks can be arranged on the four sides of the steel bar through repeated operation, the correction of the steel bar is facilitated, the shaking of the steel bar when the steel bar is subjected to vibration is prevented, the stability of the steel bar is further improved, and the problems that the building structure can be subjected to huge lateral force under the extreme conditions of earthquake and the like, the column is displaced, the steel bar in the column can be bent or misplaced, and the bearing capacity of the structure is affected are solved.
assignees: ZHUHAI CONSTRUCTION ENG HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle charges and emergency power source system based on electric automobile charging station
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle charging and emergency power supply system based on an electric vehicle charging station, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit, an emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit, an emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit, an emergency guarantee alternating current output unit and an equipment alternating current input unit, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit is connected with a charging/discharging gun and used for charging an unmanned aerial vehicle or inputting electric energy of the unmanned aerial vehicle to the system, and performing active battery capacity verification on an unmanned aerial vehicle battery, the emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit is connected with the charging gun and connected with a quick wiring terminal and used for outputting alternating current or inputting electric energy of an external device to the system, the emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit is connected with the quick wiring terminal and used for outputting alternating current with various powers, and the equipment alternating current input unit is connected with a charging station alternating current low-voltage system and used for supplying power to the unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit, the emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit, the emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit and the emergency guarantee alternating current output unit. The invention can rapidly form an unmanned aerial vehicle charging infrastructure network and an emergency shelter with a reliable emergency power supply by utilizing the existing charging station network.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINBO NEW ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for providing housing accomodations
abstract_en: The present disclosure aims to provide housing accommodations based on an applicant's response to prompts regarding the applicant's comfort with rooming with a transgender person. Embodiments of the present disclosure may include a prompt in an online, internet-based housing application that asks whether an applicant is comfortable rooming with a transgender and/or nonbinary person. This method ensures that housing assignments will comply with applicant preferences, and allow for the safe and comfortable housing assignments. It will also reduce the number of gender-related rehousing requests.

title_en: Emergency shelter layout optimization method and system based on multi-target particle swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban disaster emergency management, in particular to an emergency shelter layout optimization method and system based on a multi-target particle swarm algorithm, comprising the following steps of obtaining geographic information data, constructing an emergency shelter site optimization model aiming at minimizing evacuation distance, minimizing construction and evacuation cost and maximizing distance from a disaster hidden danger point and an emergency shelter capacity optimization model aiming at maximizing emergency shelter capacity; and carrying out joint optimization on the emergency shelter site selection optimization model and the emergency shelter capacity optimization model by utilizing a multi-target particle swarm algorithm to obtain a pareto solution set, and acquiring an emergency shelter layout scheme based on the pareto solution set. According to the invention, the optimal layout schemes of the emergency shelter with different preferences can be formed according to the combination of the geospatial features and the urban resident evacuation demands, so that the overall emergency efficiency and the resource allocation scientificity of the emergency shelter are improved.

title_en: Intelligent capacity distribution system for earthquake evacuation refuge places
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention, disaster reduction and emergency management, in particular to an intelligent capacity distribution system for an earthquake evacuation shelter, which comprises a shelter, wherein a door frame is fixedly connected to an opening of the shelter, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the door frame, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the door frame, a plurality of groups of first limiting rods which are arranged in parallel are fixedly connected to the surface of the rotating rod, and a timer shell is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the door frame. When personnel enter the pushing rotary rod to rotate, the rotary rod drives the limiting gear and the first bevel gear to rotate, and then drives the second bevel gear and the first round rod to rotate, so that the counting disc rotates to count, the number of people in the refuge cabin can be accurately counted through the design, and a precise data basis is provided for intelligent capacity distribution.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN TECH;CHINA CONSTR 5TH ENG DIVISION

title_en: Forest fire extinguishing bomb throwing device and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire extinguishing bomb throwing device and a using method, relating to the technical field of forest fire extinguishing bombs, the device comprises a bomb carrying frame, a plurality of cartridges for placing fire extinguishing bomb bodies are fixedly arranged on the bomb carrying frame, hanging rings are arranged at the tops of the fire extinguishing bomb bodies, the bottom of the ammunition cartridge is provided with a supporting mechanism for supporting and protecting the fire extinguishing bullet body, the top of the ammunition carrier is provided with a loading mechanism for limiting the fire extinguishing bullet body by matching with the hanging ring, and the loading mechanism is connected with the supporting mechanism through a transmission mechanism. According to the invention, the bullet loading mechanism limits the fire extinguishing bullet from the top through the cooperation of the toothed ring and the hanging ring, and is fixed in an up-down cooperative manner with the supporting mechanism, so that the fire extinguishing bullet is prevented from being displaced when the flying posture of the unmanned aerial vehicle changes, and the transmission mechanism can synchronously drive the inserted link to ascend and separate from the jack when the toothed ring rotates to separate the hanging ring from the opening, thereby ensuring that the fire extinguishing bullet is smoothly thrown out in an unbound state and avoiding bullet blocking.

title_en: Adaptive large-displacement multidirectional displacement comb plate expansion device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bridge protection devices, in particular to a self-adaptive large-displacement all-directional deflection comb plate expansion device which solves the problems that the transverse displacement capability is small, the large transverse displacement requirement generated by an earthquake effect is difficult to meet, meanwhile, the expansion device lacks torsion deflection functions, the expansion device of the self-adaptive large-displacement all-directional deflection comb plate expansion device simultaneously has transverse displacement, longitudinal rotation angle and horizontal rotation angle, and comprises a first comb plate and a second comb plate, one side of the first comb plate is arranged on a first beam body, one side of the second comb plate is arranged on a second beam body, comb teeth on one side, which are close to each other, of the first comb plate are staggered and inserted, a all-directional deflection support is arranged between one side of the first comb plate and the first beam body, and the bottom end of the other side of the first comb plate is provided with a multi-directional deflection device used for supporting the first comb plate, and the all-directional deflection support and the multi-directional deflection device are matched so that two sides of the first comb plate are displaced and twisted along a bridge.
assignees: CHENGDU HONGTU ROAD AND BRIDGE MACHINE CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood disaster early warning and emergency refuge system
abstract_en: An urban flood disaster early warning and emergency refuge system belongs to the technical field of urban flood disaster early warning and emergency refuge. In order to solve the problem that a scheme capable of carrying out early warning and emergency refuge guidance according to the area where flood disasters are expected to occur is lacking at present. The system comprises a flood disaster prediction and early warning unit, an emergency shelter and a path planning unit, wherein the flood disaster prediction and early warning unit is used for taking the area exceeding the threshold value of the water accumulation depth as the area where the flood disaster is likely to occur and early warning according to the weather satellite cloud image and corresponding precipitation prediction data of a target city, the ground elevation data of the city, the city construction drainage pipe network and drainage capacity data and the city road network data, the emergency shelter is screened out from the area where the flood disaster is not likely to occur based on the position of the emergency shelter, the reachability prediction is carried out, and the emergency shelter is comprehensively determined according to the cost of the reachability prediction and the elevation of the emergency shelter, and the path planning is carried out, so that the emergency shelter is evacuated.

title_en: Initial battle accuse train carries AGV intelligent fire control dolly with receive and release function fast
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and discloses a initial battle train-mounted AGV intelligent fire-fighting trolley with a rapid retraction function, which comprises a fire-fighting trolley body, a parking platform and a trolley body, wherein a first connecting plate is arranged at the tail part of the fire-fighting trolley body, the first connecting plate at the tail part of the fire-fighting trolley body and a lifting mechanism are matched with a second hinged connecting plate through the parking platform and the lifting mechanism, the second connecting plate is provided with a buffer plate, the first connecting plate is provided with a storage space, can carry out steady lift and compact accomodate to parking the platform, avoid going up and down to rock, accomodate occupation space, cooperation extensible member drive and slide rail assembly direction, through parking frame inner bottom plate support, the preliminary design that blocks of pin, realize the steady parking of dolly automobile body on the platform, solve the unstable and skew problem of parking of lift, connect plate two simultaneously and can change into accommodation space, do not influence other equipment of fire engine and use, guarantee driving and operation security.
assignees: CIXI FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE CIXI FIRE RESCUE BUREAU

title_en: Inertial control switch device and control method
abstract_en: The application provides an inertia control switch device and a control method, wherein the inertia control switch device comprises an inertia module used for capturing kinetic energy inertia when a vehicle is displaced, a switch module used for controlling on-off of a circuit and an inertia control module used for controlling swing sensitivity of the inertia module, the inertia module is arranged in an engine room or a passenger cabin of the vehicle, the switch module is arranged on the inertia module and connected with a door lock, the inertia control module is arranged around the inertia module, the inertia module and the switch module are matched with instant on-off of the control circuit to control unlocking of a vehicle door, kinetic energy inertia when the vehicle is displaced can be utilized when the vehicle collides or a bicycle accident happens, the on-off of the unlocking circuit of the vehicle door is controlled through the inertia module and the switch module in an instant manner, the vehicle door is unlocked quickly, the influence of the collision position, the strength or the angle of the vehicle or other collision automatic unlocking mechanisms of the vehicle is avoided, thus the escape capability of personnel in the vehicle is enhanced, the rescue difficulty of personnel outside the vehicle is reduced, and casualties caused by the fact that the vehicle door cannot be opened.

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to provide information on an evacuation site at the time of occurrence of a disaster and support rescue activities.SOLUTION: A system includes a navigation unit, a visualization unit, a registration unit, an upload unit, and a matching unit. The navigation unit navigates to the nearest evacuation site according to the type of disaster. The visualization unit visualizes an opening status and an accommodation status of the shelter. The registration unit registers information of a rescue requester and shares the information on a map. The upload unit uploads an image or a moving image of a disaster area to visualize a dangerous area or a non-passable area. The matching unit matches a volunteer requester with a volunteer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Shelter integrated interior decoration structure adopting composite material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shelter integrated interior decoration structure made of composite materials, and belongs to the technical field of modularized buildings. The structure comprises a top interior assembly and a bulkhead interior trim panel, wherein the top assembly adopts a quick-assembly rice-shaped aluminum profile keel to realize 3-6 m span self-adaptation, a middle suspended ceiling plate is used for improving load capacity through combination of a double-curvature bent aluminum plate and a truss reinforced profile, an integrated air duct assembly adopts gradient sound absorbing cotton and a nano plastic-spraying grille and comprises an air duct, an air duct trim panel and an air duct grille, and the lighting unit comprises a strip lamp arranged along the length direction of a cabin body and an atmosphere lamp belt arranged at the position of a side wall of a hypotenuse suspended ceiling. The bulkhead adopts an aluminum hexagonal honeycomb composite board, and three-dimensional assembly is realized through a splicing and gravity self-locking structure. The utility model realizes full modular assembly, can be cut down according to the size of the shelter, has lower manufacturing cost, improves site construction efficiency, and is suitable for rapid deployment scenes such as emergency shelter, mobile medical facilities and the like.
assignees: Anhui bowei changan electronics co ltd
